- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/bsod-dpc-watchdog-violation

- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/high-cpu-system-interrupts
- Answer: Use LatencyMon to identify faulty hardware drivers causing severe CPU spikes and stuttering from deferred procedure calls.

- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/file-explorer-crashing-freezing
- Answer: Identify and disable rogue shell extensions using ShellExView to fix instant desktop crashes when opening folders.

### Fix 'The code execution cannot proceed because VCRUNTIME140.dll was not found'
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/dll-missing-vcruntime140-msvcp140
- Answer: Properly reinstall official Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable packages for x86 and x64 architectures.

### Windows Security / Defender Service Won't Start: Error 577 & Group Policy Fix
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-defender-service-wont-start
- Answer: Restore Microsoft Defender Antivirus when disabled by remnants of third-party antivirus uninstalls.

### BSOD IRQL_NOT_LESS_OR_EQUAL (0x0000000A): RAM & Driver Conflict Fix
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/bsod-irql-not-less-or-equal
- Answer: Isolate memory access violations where kernel processes attempt to access pageable memory at too high an interrupt level.

### Windows Sandbox / WSL2 Error 0x80370102: Virtualization Not Enabled in BIOS
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-sandbox-hyperv-error-0x80370102
- Answer: Enable Intel VT-x / AMD-V SVM in motherboard firmware to allow Hyper-V, WSL2, and Windows Sandbox to launch.

### How do I fix Windows 11/10 Update error 0x800f081f (CBS_E_SOURCE_MISSING)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-11-10-update-error-0x800f081f-cbs-e-source-missing
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: Error 0x800f081f occurs when Windows Update or .NET Framework 3.5 cannot locate required component source files. Open Command Prompt as Administrator and run DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth followed by sfc /scannow, then reboot. If the update still fails, download the standalone .msu package directly from the Microsoft Update Catalog or mount a matching Windows ISO as a local DISM source.

### How do I resolve Windows Update error 0x80070643 on WinRE security updates?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-update-error-0x80070643-on-winre-security-updates
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: Error 0x80070643 during Windows Recovery Environment (WinRE) updates means the recovery partition lacks the required 250 MB of free space. Run reagentc /disable in elevated Command Prompt, shrink the primary C: partition by 250 MB in diskpart, delete and recreate the recovery partition with expanded size, then run reagentc /enable and retry Windows Update.

### Why does Windows 11 feature upgrade fail with rollback error 0xc1900101?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-11-feature-upgrade-fail-with-rollback-error-0xc1900101
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: Error 0xc1900101 is a driver-triggered upgrade rollback during the SAFE_OS or FIRST_BOOT phase. Disconnect all non-essential USB hubs, external drives, and docks; ensure at least 30 GB of free space on C:; temporarily uninstall third-party antivirus suites; update chipset, storage, and BIOS firmware from your PC manufacturer; then re-run the upgrade via the Windows 11 Installation Assistant.

### How do I fix Windows Update error 0x80070005 (Access Denied)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-update-error-0x80070005-access-denied
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: Error 0x80070005 indicates missing file or registry permissions during update installation. Sign in with an Administrator account, pause third-party security software, reset permissions on C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution, and run sfc /scannow plus DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth. If Group Policy or a corrupted user profile blocks writes, create a temporary local admin account and run Windows Update from there.

### How do I fix Windows Update error 0x80248007 or 0x8024402f?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-update-error-0x80248007-or-0x8024402f
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: Errors 0x80248007 and 0x8024402f signal interrupted Windows Update server handshakes or corrupted local metadata. Disable VPNs and proxies, run net stop wuauserv and net stop bits in elevated Command Prompt, rename C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution to SoftwareDistribution.old, restart both services, and check that system date, time, and DNS (8.8.8.8 / 1.1.1.1) are accurate.

### How do I resolve Windows 11/10 BSOD MEMORY_MANAGEMENT (0x0000001A)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-11-10-bsod-memory-management-0x0000001a
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: Stop code MEMORY_MANAGEMENT (0x0000001A) points to faulty RAM sticks, unstable XMP/EXPO overclocks, or corrupted page files. Press Win + R, run mdsched.exe (Windows Memory Diagnostic) or boot MemTest86 to test each RAM module individually, disable RAM overclocking in BIOS, update GPU/chipset drivers, and run chkdsk C: /f /r to verify disk integrity.

### How do I fix BSOD INACCESSIBLE_BOOT_DEVICE (0x0000007B) after a Windows update or BIOS change?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/bsod-inaccessible-boot-device-0x0000007b-after-a-windows-update-or-bios
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: INACCESSIBLE_BOOT_DEVICE occurs when Windows cannot load the storage controller driver (commonly after a BIOS update resets SATA/NVMe mode between Intel VMD/RAID and AHCI). Enter UEFI/BIOS and toggle Storage Mode back to its previous setting (AHCI or VMD/RAID). If unchanged, boot into WinRE, uninstall the latest quality update, or load Intel RST drivers via dism /image:C:\ /add-driver.

### How do I fix BSOD UNEXPECTED_STORE_EXCEPTION (0x00000154) on Windows 11/10?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/bsod-unexpected-store-exception-0x00000154-on-windows-11-10
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: UNEXPECTED_STORE_EXCEPTION occurs when the Windows kernel store component encounters an I/O failure on an SSD/HDD or conflict with Fast Startup. Disable Fast Startup under Control Panel > Power Options > Choose what the power buttons do, update NVMe/SSD firmware via the manufacturer utility, run chkdsk C: /f /r, and check SMART health metrics for failing drive sectors.

### How do I fix BSOD PAGE_FAULT_IN_NONPAGED_AREA (0x00000050)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/bsod-page-fault-in-nonpaged-area-0x00000050
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: Stop code 0x00000050 means a driver or system service referenced invalid memory. Boot into Safe Mode, inspect C:\Windows\Minidump to identify the faulting .sys driver, uninstall recently added antivirus or RGB/peripheral utilities, disable automatic paging file corruption by resetting virtual memory in System Properties > Performance, and run sfc /scannow plus a RAM test.

### How do I fix BSOD VIDEO_TDR_FAILURE (0x00000116, nvlddmkm.sys / amdkmdag.sys)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/bsod-video-tdr-failure-0x00000116-nvlddmkm-sys-amdkmdag-sys
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: VIDEO_TDR_FAILURE means the graphics driver stopped responding and Windows failed to reset the GPU. Boot into Safe Mode, cleanly wipe existing GPU drivers using Display Driver Uninstaller (DDU), reboot normally, install the latest WHQL NVIDIA/AMD/Intel driver with Clean Installation checked, and verify GPU temperatures and PCIe power cables.

### How do I fix BSOD SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED (0x0000007E)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/bsod-system-thread-exception-not-handled-0x0000007e
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: This BSOD occurs when a kernel-mode thread triggers an unhandled driver exception (frequently GPU, Wi-Fi, or audio drivers). Note the .sys filename shown on the blue screen, boot into Safe Mode via WinRE, roll back or uninstall that driver in Device Manager, update BIOS/chipset firmware, and run DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth.

### How do I fix BSOD WHEA_UNCORRECTABLE_ERROR (0x00000124) on Windows 11/10?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/bsod-whea-uncorrectable-error-0x00000124-on-windows-11-10
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: WHEA_UNCORRECTABLE_ERROR is a hardware-level machine check exception caused by CPU overheating, unstable undervolting/overclocking, failing NVMe SSDs, or insufficient PSU voltage. Reset BIOS to Optimized Defaults, monitor CPU/VRM temperatures, reseat the NVMe SSD and RAM, update motherboard BIOS, and run CPU/storage diagnostics to isolate failing hardware.

### How do I fix BSOD KERNEL_SECURITY_CHECK_FAILURE (0x00000139)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/bsod-kernel-security-check-failure-0x00000139
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: KERNEL_SECURITY_CHECK_FAILURE triggers when Windows detects corrupted kernel data structures from incompatible drivers, anti-cheat modules, or faulty RAM. Boot into Safe Mode, uninstall recently updated kernel-level drivers or game anti-cheats (e.g., Vanguard/EasyAntiCheat), run sfc /scannow and mdsched.exe, and ensure Core Isolation drivers are up to date.

### How do I fix Windows 11 activation error 0xC004F213 or 0xC004C003 after replacing a motherboard?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-11-activation-error-0xc004f213-or-0xc004c003-after-replacing-a-m
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: Activation errors 0xC004F213 and 0xC004C003 occur when hardware changes invalidate the stored digital license. Go to Settings > System > Activation > Troubleshoot, select I changed hardware on this device recently, sign in with the Microsoft account linked to your retail digital license, choose your previous PC, and click Activate. OEM keys tied to the old motherboard require a new retail license.

### How do I fix Windows 11 "This PC doesn't currently meet Windows 11 system requirements" (TPM 2.0 / Secure Boot)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-11-this-pc-doesn-t-currently-meet-windows-11-system-requirements
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: This error appears when TPM 2.0 (fTPM on AMD / PTT on Intel) or UEFI Secure Boot is disabled, or the drive uses legacy MBR instead of GPT. Enter BIOS/UEFI, switch Boot Mode from CSM/Legacy to UEFI, enable Secure Boot and Intel PTT/AMD fTPM, and convert the OS drive from MBR to GPT non-destructively using mbr2gpt /convert /allowFullOS in elevated Command Prompt.

### How do I fix Windows 11 PIN error "Something happened and your PIN isn't available" (0x80090011 / 0x80090027)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-11-pin-error-something-happened-and-your-pin-isn-t-available-0x8
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: This error happens when the Ngc (Windows Hello PIN) cryptographic folder becomes corrupted or TPM resets. Click Set up my PIN on the lock screen (requires internet) or sign in with your Microsoft account password. Once logged in, take ownership of C:\Windows\ServiceProfiles\LocalService\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Ngc, delete its contents, and recreate your PIN in Settings > Accounts > Sign-in options.

### How do I fix Windows 11 Start Menu and Taskbar completely frozen or not opening?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-11-start-menu-and-taskbar-completely-frozen-or-not-opening
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: A frozen Start Menu/Taskbar is usually caused by a hung ShellExperienceHost or Explorer process. Press Ctrl + Shift + Esc to open Task Manager, right-click Windows Explorer, and click Restart. If it remains unresponsive, open PowerShell (Admin) and run Get-AppxPackage Microsoft.Windows.ShellExperienceHost | Reset-AppxPackage and sfc /scannow, then reboot.

### How do I fix Windows 11/10 Search Bar not typing or showing blank results?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-11-10-search-bar-not-typing-or-showing-blank-results
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: Broken Windows Search stems from a stuck ctfmon.exe input process or corrupted Search index. Press Win + R, run C:\Windows\System32\ctfmon.exe to restore typing immediately, then open Services (services.msc) and restart Windows Search. For blank results, go to Settings > Privacy & security > Searching Windows > Advanced indexing options > Rebuild.

### How do I fix Windows 11/10 "Your microphone is not working" in Zoom, Teams, or Chrome?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-11-10-your-microphone-is-not-working-in-zoom-teams-or-chrome
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: Missing mic audio is most commonly blocked by Windows Privacy toggles or an incorrect default communications device. Open Settings > Privacy & security > Microphone and enable Microphone access plus Let desktop apps access your microphone. Then open Settings > System > Sound > Input, pick the right mic, verify input volume is above 80%, and disable audio enhancements.

### How do I fix Windows 11/10 webcam showing a black screen or error 0xA00F4244 (NoCamerasAreAttached)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-11-10-webcam-showing-a-black-screen-or-error-0xa00f4244-nocamera
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: Error 0xA00F4244 happens due to a physical privacy shutter/Fn camera toggle, blocked Privacy permissions, or antivirus webcam protection. Check your laptop's physical lens slider and Fn + Camera key, enable Settings > Privacy & security > Camera, disable webcam blocking in Norton/Bitdefender/Kaspersky, and reinstall the camera driver in Device Manager.

### How do I fix Windows 11/10 laptop Wi-Fi icon missing completely from the Taskbar?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-11-10-laptop-wi-fi-icon-missing-completely-from-the-taskbar
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: A vanished Wi-Fi icon indicates a crashed WLAN adapter driver or disabled WlanSvc service. Perform a hard power drain (shut down, unplug power, hold Power button 30 seconds), open Device Manager > Network adapters (enable Show hidden devices), uninstall the Wi-Fi adapter without deleting drivers, and reboot. Also ensure WLAN AutoConfig is set to Automatic in services.msc.

### How do I fix Windows 11/10 Print Spooler keeps stopping or printer stuck on "Error - Printing"?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-11-10-print-spooler-keeps-stopping-or-printer-stuck-on-error-pri
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: Stuck print jobs corrupt the C:\Windows\System32\spool\PRINTERS queue and crash the spooler. Open elevated Command Prompt, run net stop spooler, delete all files inside C:\Windows\System32\spool\PRINTERS, then run net start spooler. If it crashes again, remove WSD ports and recreate the printer using a Standard TCP/IP Port with the manufacturer's PCL/PS driver.

### How do I fix Windows 11/10 external hard drive not showing up in File Explorer (RAW / Unallocated)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-11-10-external-hard-drive-not-showing-up-in-file-explorer-raw-un
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: Drives missing in File Explorer often lack an assigned drive letter or have a corrupted partition table. Press Win + X > Disk Management: if the drive shows a healthy partition without a letter, right-click it and select Change Drive Letter and Paths > Add. If it reads RAW, do not format it—run chkdsk X: /f or use read-only recovery software first to protect your data.

### How do I fix Windows 11/10 battery stuck at 0% or "Plugged in, not charging"?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-11-10-battery-stuck-at-0-or-plugged-in-not-charging
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: This occurs from ACPI battery driver glitches, OEM battery-conservation limits (e.g., Lenovo Vantage/ASUS MyASUS 60%–80% cap), or underpowered USB-C chargers. Check your OEM utility for Battery Charge Thresholds, verify the charger wattage matches OEM specs, open Device Manager > Batteries, uninstall Microsoft ACPI-Compliant Control Method Battery, shut down, unplug for 60 seconds, and reboot.

### How do I fix Windows 11 laptop overheating and loud fan noise when idle?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-11-laptop-overheating-and-loud-fan-noise-when-idle
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: High idle heat is usually caused by stuck Windows Update/Search indexing, Modern Standby wake loops, or aggressive Processor Performance Boost settings. Check Task Manager for runaway background CPU processes, switch Power Mode to Balanced, clean intake vents with compressed air, update BIOS/chipset drivers, and disable Wake Timers in Advanced Power Settings.

### How do I fix Windows 11 Modern Standby battery drain overnight while laptop lid is closed?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-11-modern-standby-battery-drain-overnight-while-laptop-lid-is-cl
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: Modern Standby (S0 Low Power Idle) keeps Wi-Fi active during sleep, causing laptops to stay warm and drain 30%–50% in a bag. Unplug power *before* closing the lid (a known S0 transition bug), configure Hibernate instead of Sleep for closing the lid on battery in Control Panel > Power Options, and run powercfg /sleepstudy to pinpoint waking devices.

### How do I fix Windows 11 second monitor not detected via HDMI or USB-C?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-11-second-monitor-not-detected-via-hdmi-or-usb-c
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: Press Win + P and select Extend. Confirm the USB-C port supports DisplayPort Alt Mode (not charge-only), test a direct cable without cheap adapters, press Win + Ctrl + Shift + B to reset the graphics driver, and update both integrated (Intel/AMD) and dedicated (NVIDIA) graphics drivers.

### How do I fix Windows 11/10 Clipboard History (Win + V) or Snipping Tool not working?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-11-10-clipboard-history-win-v-or-snipping-tool-not-working
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: Enable Clipboard History under Settings > System > Clipboard. For a broken Snipping Tool, go to Settings > Apps > Installed apps > Snipping Tool > Advanced options > Repair (then Reset), and verify your system clock is set to Automatic (an expired certificate or wrong clock breaks UWP app launches).

### How do I fix Windows 11 "Your PC will automatically restart in one minute" (lsass.exe / wininit crash)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-11-your-pc-will-automatically-restart-in-one-minute-lsass-exe-wi
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: A forced 1-minute shutdown indicates a critical system process (lsass.exe, DCOM Server, or RPC) crashed. Cancel an active shutdown timer temporarily via shutdown /a in Command Prompt, inspect Event Viewer > Windows Logs > System for the faulting DLL/update, uninstall recent conflicting updates or security agents, and run sfc /scannow + DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth.

### How do I fix Windows 11/10 Error 0x80070035: The network path was not found on local file shares?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-11-10-error-0x80070035-the-network-path-was-not-found-on-local-f
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: Windows 11 24H2 enforces SMB signing and disables insecure guest logons by default, breaking access to older NAS/shared PCs. Set the network profile to Private, enable File and Printer Sharing in Firewall, authenticate with explicit NAS username/password credentials instead of guest access, or update your NAS firmware to support SMBv3 with signing.

### How do I fix Windows 11/10 MSVCP140.dll or d3dx9_43.dll missing when launching games or apps?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-11-10-msvcp140-dll-or-d3dx9-43-dll-missing-when-launching-games
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: Missing d3dx9_43.dll requires the official DirectX End-User Runtime Web Installer from Microsoft (not third-party DLL download sites), while MSVCP140.dll requires installing BOTH the x86 and x64 Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 Redistributable packages and rebooting.

### How do I fix Windows 11/10 File Explorer showing "Working on it..." forever when opening folders?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-11-10-file-explorer-showing-working-on-it-forever-when-opening-f
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: Endless "Working on it..." occurs when Explorer tries to parse broken thumbnails, unreachable mapped network drives, or Quick Access shortcuts. Open Folder Options > General, click Clear next to File Explorer history, disconnect offline mapped network drives, and switch folder optimization under Properties > Customize from Pictures/Videos to General items.

### How do I fix Windows 11 Remote Desktop (RDP) error "An authentication error has occurred (CredSSP encryption oracle remediation)"?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-11-remote-desktop-rdp-error-an-authentication-error-has-occurred
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: This error happens when the client and host PCs have mismatched CredSSP security patch levels. Install all pending Windows Updates on both machines. As a temporary administrative bridge on trusted LANs, configure Encryption Oracle Remediation under gpedit.msc (Computer Configuration > Administrative Templates > System > Credentials Delegation) until both hosts are patched.

### How do I fix Windows 11/10 System Restore failing with error 0x80070091 or 0x80070005?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-11-10-system-restore-failing-with-error-0x80070091-or-0x80070005
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: System Restore fails when active antivirus software locks WindowsApps or Volume Shadow Copy files. Boot into Safe Mode (or WinRE > Troubleshoot > System Restore), temporarily disable third-party antivirus real-time protection, ensure Volume Shadow Copy (VSS) service is running, and retry System Restore from WinRE.

### How do I fix Windows 11/10 high RAM usage (80%–95%) with no large apps open (Non-Paged Pool leak)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-11-10-high-ram-usage-80-95-with-no-large-apps-open-non-paged-poo
- Sub-Topic: Windows 11 & Windows 10
- Answer: A ballooning Non-paged pool in Task Manager > Performance > Memory signals a kernel driver memory leak (commonly Killer Networking, Realtek LAN, or outdated VPN drivers). Update network/motherboard drivers directly from the hardware vendor, disable Memory Compression testing only after checking poolmon, and uninstall bloatware network "prioritizer" suites.

### How do I fix "Cannot start Microsoft Outlook. Cannot open the Outlook window" (0x80004005)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/cannot-start-microsoft-outlook-cannot-open-the-outlook-window-0x80004005
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Outlook
- Answer: This error is caused by a corrupted Navigation Pane file (profilename.xml), damaged OST file, or Outlook stuck in Compatibility Mode. Press Win + R and run outlook.exe /resetnavpane. If it persists, right-click OUTLOOK.EXE > Properties > Compatibility and uncheck Run this program in compatibility mode, or create a fresh profile in Control Panel > Mail.

### How do I fix Outlook Send/Receive error 0x800CCC0E (Cannot connect to server)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/outlook-send-receive-error-0x800ccc0e-cannot-connect-to-server
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Outlook
- Answer: Error 0x800CCC0E occurs when OAuth2 tokens expire (common with Gmail/Yahoo in Outlook), firewall/antivirus email scanning blocks ports, or IMAP/SMTP ports are wrong. Close Outlook, open Windows Credential Manager > Generic Credentials, delete MicrosoftOffice16_Data:OAUTH2 entries for that email, verify IMAP port 993 (SSL/TLS) and SMTP port 587 (STARTTLS), and re-authenticate.

### How do I fix Outlook error 0x800CCC0F (Connection to the server was interrupted)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/outlook-error-0x800ccc0f-connection-to-the-server-was-interrupted
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Outlook
- Answer: Error 0x800CCC0F is triggered by an oversized stuck email in the Outbox, antivirus SSL email scanning interference, or server timeout. Switch Outlook to Work Offline, delete the stuck email from Outbox, increase Server Timeouts to 5 minutes under Account Settings > More Settings > Advanced, and disable outbound email scanning in your third-party antivirus.

### How do I fix New Outlook for Windows crashing immediately upon launch after a Windows 11 update?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/new-outlook-for-windows-crashing-immediately-upon-launch-after-a-windows
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Outlook
- Answer: New Outlook (olk.exe) stores local WebView2 cache that corrupts after Edge/Windows updates. Open Settings > Apps > Installed apps > Outlook (new) > Advanced options, click Repair and then Reset (re-syncs cloud mailboxes without deleting server emails), and repair Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime from Installed Apps.

### How do I switch back from New Outlook to Classic Outlook on Windows 11?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/back-from-new-outlook-to-classic-outlook-on-windows-11
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Outlook
- Answer: Toggle off New Outlook in the top-right title bar of the app. If the toggle is missing, press Win + R, open regedit, go to HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Office\16.0\Outlook\Preferences, set UseNewOutlook to 0, and launch Classic Outlook from C:\Program Files\Microsoft Office\root\Office16\OUTLOOK.EXE.

### How do I fix Outlook stuck on "Trying to connect..." or "Disconnected" on Microsoft 365?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/outlook-stuck-on-trying-to-connect-or-disconnected-on-microsoft-365
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Outlook
- Answer: This occurs from stale Modern Authentication tokens or corrupted IdentityCache. Sign out of Office, close all Office apps, open Credential Manager and remove all MicrosoftOffice16 and ADAL entries, delete %localappdata%\Packages\Microsoft.AAD.BrokerPlugin_* cache (or run Microsoft Support and Recovery Assistant / Get Help), and sign back in.

### How do I fix Outlook Search not returning results or missing recent emails?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/outlook-search-not-returning-results-or-missing-recent-emails
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Outlook
- Answer: Broken Outlook search stems from a corrupted Windows Search index or faulty OST indexing. Go to File > Options > Search > Indexing Options > Modify, verify Microsoft Outlook is checked, then click Advanced > Rebuild. Also verify the Windows Search service is running in services.msc.

### How do I fix Outlook error "The set of folders cannot be opened" or "Errors have been detected in the file .ost / .pst"?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/outlook-error-the-set-of-folders-cannot-be-opened-or-errors-have-been-de
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Outlook
- Answer: This indicates a corrupted Outlook data file. Close Outlook, run Microsoft's built-in Inbox Repair Tool (SCANPST.EXE, located in C:\Program Files\Microsoft Office\root\Office16\) on .pst files. For Exchange/Microsoft 365 .ost files, simply rename the .ost file in %localappdata%\Microsoft\Outlook to .ost.bak and restart Outlook to rebuild a clean copy from the server.

### How do I fix Outlook "Cannot expand the folder" or "Your mailbox has reached its maximum size limit" (50 GB OST limit)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/outlook-cannot-expand-the-folder-or-your-mailbox-has-reached-its-maximum
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Outlook
- Answer: Classic Outlook enforces a default 50 GB limit on .ost/.pst files. Archive older emails to an Online Archive or local PST, empty Deleted Items, compact the data file via Account Settings > Data Files > Settings > Compact Now, and reduce the Cached Exchange Mode slider from "All" to "1 year" to keep the local OST lean.

### How do I fix Outlook error "Not implemented" when clicking Send, Reply, or Forward?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/outlook-error-not-implemented-when-clicking-send-reply-or-forward
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Outlook
- Answer: The "Not implemented" error is caused by a corrupted SRS (Send/Receive Settings) file, faulty add-in, or damaged Office installation. Rename %appdata%\Microsoft\Outlook\*.srs to .srs.old, test Outlook in Safe Mode (outlook.exe /safe) to disable conflicting add-ins, and run Online Repair for Microsoft 365 in Settings > Apps.

### How do I fix Outlook emails stuck in the Outbox and refusing to send?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/outlook-emails-stuck-in-the-outbox-and-refusing-to-send
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Outlook
- Answer: Emails stall in the Outbox when attachments exceed server limits (typically 20–25 MB), Outlook is in Work Offline mode, or you opened the queued message while sending. Click Send/Receive > Work Offline to verify you are online, open Outbox, move the message to Drafts, compress or link large files via OneDrive, and resend.

### How do I fix Outlook shared mailbox folders not updating or sent items going to the wrong Sent folder?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/outlook-shared-mailbox-folders-not-updating-or-sent-items-going-to-the-w
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Outlook
- Answer: Auto-mapped shared mailboxes lag when Download shared folders fills the local OST cache. Go to Account Settings > Change > More Settings > Advanced and uncheck Download shared folders so Outlook reads the shared mailbox live. To save replies in the shared mailbox's Sent Items, enable MessageCopyForSentAsEnabled in Exchange Admin Center.

### How do I fix Gmail not syncing in Outlook after Google removed "Less Secure Apps"?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/gmail-not-syncing-in-outlook-after-google-removed-less-secure-apps
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Outlook
- Answer: Classic Outlook older than 2019 (or POP/IMAP setups without OAuth2) fail Google's modern security check. Update Office to Microsoft 365 / Outlook 2021+ which supports OAuth2 natively, or enable 2-Step Verification on your Google Account, generate a 16-character Google App Password, and paste that App Password into Outlook's IMAP/SMTP password field.

### How do I fix Outlook attachments not previewing ("This file cannot be previewed because of an error with the previewer")?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/outlook-attachments-not-previewing-this-file-cannot-be-previewed-because
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Outlook
- Answer: Broken attachment previews occur when the PDF/Word preview handler is disabled or Protected View conflicts with Adobe/Edge. In Outlook, go to File > Options > Trust Center > Trust Center Settings > Attachment Handling, uncheck Turn off Attachment Preview, click Attachment and Document Previewers, enable the required handlers, and repair Office if Word/Excel previewers still fail.

### How do I fix Outlook Calendar invitations not sending or disappearing after accepting?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/outlook-calendar-invitations-not-sending-or-disappearing-after-accepting
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Outlook
- Answer: Missing calendar invites happen when auto-processing rules or delegate permissions corrupt calendar items. Go to File > Options > Mail > Tracking and verify Update tracking information, and then delete responses that don't contain comments is configured as desired, run outlook.exe /cleanreminders and outlook.exe /resetfolders, and check Outlook on the Web (outlook.office.com) to isolate local vs. server rules.

### How do I fix Outlook hyperlinks blocked with "Your organization's policies are preventing us from completing this action"?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/outlook-hyperlinks-blocked-with-your-organization-s-policies-are-prevent
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Outlook
- Answer: This happens after uninstalling Chrome/Firefox without resetting the Windows default browser registry association. Open Settings > Apps > Default apps, set Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome as default for HTTP, HTTPS, and .htm/.html, and verify HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT\.html default value is htmlfile or your active browser's ProgID.

### How do I fix Outlook error 0x8004010F ("Outlook data file cannot be accessed")?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/outlook-error-0x8004010f-outlook-data-file-cannot-be-accessed
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Outlook
- Answer: Error 0x8004010F means the Outlook profile points to a moved, deleted, or OneDrive-locked .pst file. Never store active .pst files inside a synced OneDrive folder—move the .pst to C:\Users\<Name>\Outlook Files, then create a new profile in Control Panel > Mail > Show Profiles and point delivery to the relocated file.

### How do I fix Outlook.com / Hotmail "Mailbox is full" even after deleting emails?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/outlook-com-hotmail-mailbox-is-full-even-after-deleting-emails
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Outlook
- Answer: Microsoft combines OneDrive and Outlook.com attachment storage under one Microsoft Storage quota. Deleting emails without emptying Deleted Items > Recover items deleted from this folder—or having a full OneDrive—keeps Outlook.com locked. Visit account.microsoft.com/storage to check both Microsoft Storage (OneDrive + attachments) and Email Storage, purge large attachments, and wait up to 2 hours for quota sync.

### How do I fix Outlook showing "We couldn't create the Outlook data file" when adding a new account?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/outlook-showing-we-couldn-t-create-the-outlook-data-file-when-adding-a-n
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Outlook
- Answer: This occurs when Controlled Folder Access (Windows Defender) or OneDrive Known Folder Backup blocks write permissions to Documents\Outlook Files. Allow OUTLOOK.EXE through Controlled Folder Access, verify write permissions on %localappdata%\Microsoft\Outlook, and run Outlook once as Administrator to initialize the profile.

### How do I fix Outlook Mobile (iOS/Android) not sending push notifications for new emails?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/outlook-mobile-ios-android-not-sending-push-notifications-for-new-emails
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Outlook
- Answer: Delayed or missing Outlook mobile alerts are caused by Focused Inbox filtering, Do Not Disturb schedules, or aggressive battery optimization. In Outlook Mobile go to Settings > Notifications and set Allow Notifications to All Mail (not just Focused), then disable Battery Optimization / enable Background App Refresh for Outlook in iOS/Android system settings.

### How do I fix Microsoft 365 error "Unlicensed Product" or "Most features of Word/Excel have been disabled"?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-365-error-unlicensed-product-or-most-features-of-word-excel-ha
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Excel, Word & PowerPoint
- Answer: This occurs when your subscription expired, a conflicting trial/preinstalled Office license exists, or cached activation tokens broke. Confirm your active subscription at account.microsoft.com/services, sign out of all Office apps, run Microsoft's OLicenseCleanup / Microsoft 365 Activation Troubleshooter to clear stale SPP tokens, and sign back in with the licensed Microsoft account.

### How do I fix Microsoft Office installation error 30015-11 or 30183-27?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-office-installation-error-30015-11-or-30183-27
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Excel, Word & PowerPoint
- Answer: Click-to-Run error codes 30015-11 and 30183-27 result from antivirus/firewall blocking the Office CDN, insufficient disk space, or leftover older Office MSI builds. Disable VPN/third-party antivirus temporarily, free 10+ GB on C:, run the official Microsoft 365 Uninstall Troubleshooter to purge remnants, reboot, and install using the Offline Installer from account.microsoft.com.

### How do I fix Microsoft Office error 0x80070005 or CAA50021 ("Something went wrong" sign-in error)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-office-error-0x80070005-or-caa50021-something-went-wrong-sign
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Excel, Word & PowerPoint
- Answer: Sign-in error CAA50021 / 0x80070005 happens when the Windows Web Account Manager (WAM) broker loses device registration. Go to Settings > Accounts > Access work or school, disconnect and reconnect your Microsoft 365 account (or toggle Accounts used by other apps), clear %localappdata%\Microsoft\TokenBroker\Cache, and restart Office.

### How do I fix "Excel ran out of resources while attempting to calculate one or more formulas"?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/excel-ran-out-of-resources-while-attempting-to-calculate-one-or-more-for
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Excel, Word & PowerPoint
- Answer: This triggers from volatile formulas (OFFSET, INDIRECT) across whole columns, corrupted formatting in unused million-row cells, or multi-threaded calculation bugs. Press Ctrl + End to locate and delete bloated empty rows/columns, switch File > Options > Formulas > Enable multi-threaded calculation to Manual (1–2 threads) or upgrade from 32-bit to 64-bit Office for large workbooks.

### How do I fix Excel opening a blank gray screen when double-clicking .xlsx files?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/excel-opening-a-blank-gray-screen-when-double-clicking-xlsx-files
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Excel, Word & PowerPoint
- Answer: A blank gray Excel window is caused by the Ignore other applications that use DDE setting or faulty COM add-ins. Open Excel, go to File > Options > Advanced > General, uncheck Ignore other applications that use Dynamic Data Exchange (DDE), disable hardware acceleration, and test excel /safe to identify crashing add-ins.

### How do I fix "Excel cannot open the file because the file format or file extension is not valid"?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/excel-cannot-open-the-file-because-the-file-format-or-file-extension-is
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Excel, Word & PowerPoint
- Answer: This error means the file is corrupted, misnamed (e.g., an HTML/CSV export saved with .xlsx), or blocked by Windows Mark of the Web. Right-click the file > Properties > check Unblock if present. If still unreadable, open Excel > File > Open > Browse, click the arrow next to Open, and choose Open and Repair.

### How do I fix Excel macros blocked with "Microsoft has blocked macros from running because the source of this file is untrusted"?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/excel-macros-blocked-with-microsoft-has-blocked-macros-from-running-beca
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Excel, Word & PowerPoint
- Answer: Windows automatically attaches a Zone.Identifier (Mark of the Web) tag to .xlsm files downloaded from the internet or email. Right-click the .xlsm file in File Explorer > Properties > check Unblock > Apply (for files from verified sources only), or store trusted workbooks inside an explicitly configured Trusted Location in Excel's Trust Center.

### How do I fix Excel formulas showing as text (e.g., =SUM(A1:A10)) instead of calculating results?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/excel-formulas-showing-as-text-e-g-sum-a1-a10-instead-of-calculating-res
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Excel, Word & PowerPoint
- Answer: Formulas display literally when the cell is formatted as Text or Show Formulas mode is toggled on. Press Ctrl +   (backtick) to toggle off Show Formulas, change the cell Number Format from Text to General, press F2 then Enter (or run Data > Text to Columns > Finish), and check that Formulas > Calculation Options is set to Automatic.

### How do I fix Excel crashing or freezing when copying and pasting cells?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/excel-crashing-or-freezing-when-copying-and-pasting-cells
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Excel, Word & PowerPoint
- Answer: Copy/paste freezes are caused by clipboard manager extensions, Skype/Teams click-to-call add-ins, or thousands of hidden styles/shapes on a worksheet. Run excel /safe to confirm an add-in conflict, disable third-party clipboard utilities, turn off Live Preview in File > Options > General, and repair Office via Online Repair.

### How do I fix Microsoft Word crashing with "Word experienced an error trying to open the file" (Protected View)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-word-crashing-with-word-experienced-an-error-trying-to-open-th
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Excel, Word & PowerPoint
- Answer: Downloaded .docx files trigger Protected View crashes when the DCOM/sandbox permissions or Trusted Locations conflict. Right-click the file > Properties > Unblock, or in Word go to File > Options > Trust Center > Trust Center Settings > Protected View to verify sandbox settings, and use Open and Repair if the XML inside the .docx is damaged.

### How do I recover an unsaved Microsoft Word document after a crash or power outage?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/an-unsaved-microsoft-word-document-after-a-crash-or-power-outage
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Excel, Word & PowerPoint
- Answer: Open Word, go to File > Info > Manage Document > Recover Unsaved Documents (which opens %localappdata%\Microsoft\Office\UnsavedFiles) to inspect .asd AutoRecover files. Also check File > Open > Recent > Recover Unsaved Documents at the bottom, and search C: for *.asd and *.wbk backup files.

### How do I fix Microsoft Word "Normal.dotm" template corruption causing weird fonts or instant crashes?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-word-normal-dotm-template-corruption-causing-weird-fonts-or-in
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Excel, Word & PowerPoint
- Answer: A corrupted global template (Normal.dotm) breaks formatting or causes startup crashes across every document. Close Word completely, navigate to %appdata%\Microsoft\Templates, rename Normal.dotm to Normal.dotm.old, and relaunch Word—it automatically generates a clean factory Normal.dotm.

### How do I fix Microsoft Word "File is locked for editing by another user" when nobody else has it open?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-word-file-is-locked-for-editing-by-another-user-when-nobody-el
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Excel, Word & PowerPoint
- Answer: Leftover hidden lock files (~$DocumentName.docx) or OneDrive sync lag leave documents falsely locked. Close Word, end any orphaned WINWORD.EXE processes in Task Manager, enable Hidden items in File Explorer to delete the ~$ owner file, or sign out and back into OneDrive if the lock is cloud-side.

### How do I fix PowerPoint "PowerPoint found a problem with content in [file].pptx" repair prompt?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/powerpoint-powerpoint-found-a-problem-with-content-in-file-pptx-repair-p
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Excel, Word & PowerPoint
- Answer: This occurs from embedded corrupted media, unsupported fonts, or Protected View blocking downloaded decks. Right-click the .pptx > Properties > Unblock. If it still fails, open a blank presentation and use Home > New Slide > Reuse Slides to import intact slides from the damaged deck without carrying over the corrupted XML wrapper.

### How do I fix PowerPoint video or audio not playing during a presentation ("Codec unavailable")?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/powerpoint-video-or-audio-not-playing-during-a-presentation-codec-unavai
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Excel, Word & PowerPoint
- Answer: PowerPoint fails to play HEVC/MOV/MKV videos lacking Windows codecs. Convert embedded videos to standard MP4 (H.264 video + AAC audio), run File > Info > Optimize Media Compatibility inside PowerPoint, and ensure the video is embedded rather than linked to a broken local file path.

### How do I fix Office 365 error 0xc0000142 when opening Word, Excel, or PowerPoint?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/office-365-error-0xc0000142-when-opening-word-excel-or-powerpoint
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Excel, Word & PowerPoint
- Answer: Error 0xc0000142 indicates broken Office DLL dependencies or Click-to-Run service corruption. Open Services (services.msc), verify Microsoft Office Click-to-Run Service is set to Automatic and Running, then open Settings > Apps > Installed apps > Microsoft 365 > Modify > Online Repair (not Quick Repair).

### How do I fix Microsoft 365 AutoSave grayed out in Word and Excel?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-365-autosave-grayed-out-in-word-and-excel
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Excel, Word & PowerPoint
- Answer: AutoSave only works for modern file formats (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx) stored directly in OneDrive or SharePoint. Convert legacy .doc/.xls files via File > Save As to .docx/.xlsx, save the file inside your synced OneDrive folder, and ensure Use Office applications to sync Office files that I open is enabled in OneDrive Settings.

### How do I fix Microsoft Office apps asking to sign in every single time I open them?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-office-apps-asking-to-sign-in-every-single-time-i-open-them
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Excel, Word & PowerPoint
- Answer: Repeated sign-in prompts are caused by conflicting work/personal Microsoft accounts in Windows Settings or corrupted WAM credentials. Open Settings > Accounts > Email & accounts / Access work or school, remove unused/old organization accounts, clear Office entries in Windows Credential Manager, and check Allow my organization to manage my device only for active corporate accounts.

### How do I fix Microsoft 365 "Account Notice: We've run into a problem with your subscription" after renewing?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-365-account-notice-we-ve-run-into-a-problem-with-your-subscrip
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Excel, Word & PowerPoint
- Answer: Local Office apps cache license expiration timestamps for up to 72 hours after renewal. Confirm the renewal shows Active at account.microsoft.com/services, then open Word/Excel > File > Account > Update License, sign in again, and restart all Office apps to force an immediate entitlement refresh.

### How do I fix Microsoft Office spellcheck/editor not working or switching to the wrong language?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-office-spellcheck-editor-not-working-or-switching-to-the-wrong
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Excel, Word & PowerPoint
- Answer: Word/Outlook inherit proofing language per paragraph or from Windows keyboard layouts. Press Ctrl + A, go to Review > Language > Set Proofing Language, select your language, uncheck Do not check spelling or grammar and Detect language automatically, then click Set As Default.

### Why are my OneDrive shared folders suddenly showing up as .url internet shortcuts instead of local folders?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/my-onedrive-shared-folders-suddenly-showing-up-as-url-internet-shortcuts
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft OneDrive, SharePoint & Teams
- Answer: This is a known Microsoft OneDrive backend migration issue affecting consumer Shared Folders synced to File Explorer. Access the full folder contents via onedrive.live.com in your browser until Microsoft completes the account migration, avoid deleting the .url shortcut (which removes the share), and verify your OneDrive desktop client is updated to the latest build.

### How do I fix OneDrive "Your OneDrive is full" or frozen account even after deleting gigabytes of files?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/onedrive-your-onedrive-is-full-or-frozen-account-even-after-deleting-gig
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft OneDrive, SharePoint & Teams
- Answer: Deleted OneDrive files remain counted against your storage quota inside the OneDrive Recycle Bin (and Second-Stage Recycle Bin on business accounts), and Outlook.com attachments share the same Microsoft Storage pool. Sign in to onedrive.live.com, empty Recycle bin, check account.microsoft.com/storage for Outlook attachment usage, and wait up to 2 hours for quota release.

### How do I fix OneDrive red X icon or "Sync conflict: We couldn't merge your changes"?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/onedrive-red-x-icon-or-sync-conflict-we-couldn-t-merge-your-changes
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft OneDrive, SharePoint & Teams
- Answer: Sync conflicts occur when two devices edit the same file offline or invalid characters (* : < > ? / \ |) / paths over 400 characters exist in filenames. Click the OneDrive cloud tray icon > View sync problems, rename invalid filenames, choose Keep both copies or Open in Office to merge, and reset OneDrive via %localappdata%\Microsoft\OneDrive\onedrive.exe /reset if the red X sticks.

### How do I stop OneDrive from automatically moving my Desktop, Documents, and Pictures folders to the cloud?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/onedrive-from-automatically-moving-my-desktop-documents-and-pictures-fol
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft OneDrive, SharePoint & Teams
- Answer: OneDrive Known Folder Move automatically redirects user folders unless disabled. Click the OneDrive tray icon > Settings (gear) > Sync and backup > Manage backup, toggle off Desktop, Documents, and Pictures, then move any cloud-only files back from C:\Users\<Name>\OneDrive\Desktop to C:\Users\<Name>\Desktop before unlinking OneDrive.

### How do I fix OneDrive error 0x8004de40 or 0x8004de44 ("There was a problem connecting to OneDrive")?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/onedrive-error-0x8004de40-or-0x8004de44-there-was-a-problem-connecting-t
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft OneDrive, SharePoint & Teams
- Answer: Error 0x8004de40 indicates TLS 1.2/1.3 misconfiguration, proxy interference, or stale network credentials. Open Internet Options > Advanced, confirm Use TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3 are checked, disable VPN/proxy, reset Winsock (netsh winsock reset), and run onedrive.exe /reset from Win + R.

### How do I fix OneDrive "Files On-Demand" error 0x8007016A (The cloud file provider is not running)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/onedrive-files-on-demand-error-0x8007016a-the-cloud-file-provider-is-not
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft OneDrive, SharePoint & Teams
- Answer: Error 0x8007016A occurs when you try to open or delete a cloud placeholder file while OneDrive is closed or signed out. Launch OneDrive from the Start Menu and wait for sign-in to complete, or right-click the folder and select Always keep on this device so files download locally.

### How do I fix Microsoft Teams (New Teams) stuck in an infinite sign-in loop or error CAA2000B / 80090016?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-teams-new-teams-stuck-in-an-infinite-sign-in-loop-or-error-caa
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft OneDrive, SharePoint & Teams
- Answer: Sign-in loops stem from corrupted Teams WebView2 cache or broken TPM/WAM device tokens (80090016). Quit Teams completely, open Settings > Apps > Installed apps > Microsoft Teams > Advanced options > Reset, delete %userprofile%\AppData\Local\Packages\MSTeams_8wekyb3d8bbwe\LocalCache\Microsoft\MSTeams, and sign back in.

### How do I clear the Microsoft Teams cache on Windows 11 (New Teams vs. Classic Teams)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/the-microsoft-teams-cache-on-windows-11-new-teams-vs-classic-teams
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft OneDrive, SharePoint & Teams
- Answer: For New Teams, quit Teams from the system tray, open Settings > Apps > Installed apps > Microsoft Teams > Advanced options > Reset (or delete %localappdata%\Packages\MSTeams_8wekyb3d8bbwe). For Classic Teams, delete all contents inside %appdata%\Microsoft\Teams and relaunch.

### How do I fix Microsoft Teams not opening on Windows 11 ARM PCs (Surface Pro / Snapdragon X)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-teams-not-opening-on-windows-11-arm-pcs-surface-pro-snapdragon
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft OneDrive, SharePoint & Teams
- Answer: Teams fails on Windows ARM devices if an older x86/x64 bootstrapper conflicts with the native ARM64 MSIX package or WebView2 runtime. Uninstall all Teams entries in Installed apps, update Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime (ARM64), and install the official native ARM64 New Teams package via teamsbootstrapper.exe -p.

### How do I fix Microsoft Teams microphone or speaker not working during meetings?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-teams-microphone-or-speaker-not-working-during-meetings
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft OneDrive, SharePoint & Teams
- Answer: Teams often grabs the wrong Bluetooth Hands-Free profile or gets muted by Windows App Permissions. Inside Teams go to Settings > Devices, pick the exact speaker and mic (avoid "Hands-Free AG Audio" if a dedicated headset mic exists), click Make a test call, and verify Settings > Privacy & security > Microphone allows desktop apps.

### How do I fix Microsoft Teams screen sharing showing a black screen on Windows 11 or macOS?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-teams-screen-sharing-showing-a-black-screen-on-windows-11-or-m
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft OneDrive, SharePoint & Teams
- Answer: On Windows 11, disable GPU hardware acceleration or update graphics drivers and avoid sharing DRM-protected browser tabs. On macOS, open System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen & System Audio Recording, toggle Microsoft Teams off and back on, then quit and relaunch Teams.

### How do I fix Microsoft Teams "We couldn't connect you to the meeting" or constant call drops?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-teams-we-couldn-t-connect-you-to-the-meeting-or-constant-call
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft OneDrive, SharePoint & Teams
- Answer: Meeting drops are typically triggered by VPN split-tunneling, UDP ports 3478–3481 blocked by firewalls, or aggressive Wi-Fi roaming. Disconnect corporate/consumer VPNs, test teams.microsoft.com in Edge/Chrome to separate app vs. network issues, and whitelist *.teams.microsoft.com UDP 3478–3481 on your router/firewall.

### How do I fix SharePoint "Access Denied" or "You need permission to access this site" when signed into the right email?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/sharepoint-access-denied-or-you-need-permission-to-access-this-site-when
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft OneDrive, SharePoint & Teams
- Answer: This occurs when browsers mix personal Microsoft accounts with work Microsoft 365 sessions. Open an InPrivate/Incognito window and sign in strictly with the invited work email, confirm with the SharePoint owner that external sharing is enabled for your domain, and clear cached cookies for *.sharepoint.com and login.microsoftonline.com.

### How do I fix SharePoint document library failing to sync with OneDrive ("We can't sync this library")?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/sharepoint-document-library-failing-to-sync-with-onedrive-we-can-t-sync
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft OneDrive, SharePoint & Teams
- Answer: Libraries with Required Checkout, Information Rights Management (IRM), or over 100,000 synced items across all libraries stall OneDrive sync. Use Add shortcut to OneDrive only for specific subfolders (not entire 100k-file sites), disable forced checkout if not required, and remove duplicate overlapping shortcuts.

### How do I fix Microsoft OneNote sync error 0xE000002E or 0xE000078B (Server timeout)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-onenote-sync-error-0xe000002e-or-0xe000078b-server-timeout
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft OneDrive, SharePoint & Teams
- Answer: OneNote sync errors happen when a single section exceeds size limits, credentials expire, or the local cache corrupts. Open the notebook in OneNote for the Web first to confirm what is safely saved online, back up unsynced pages to a new section, close and reopen the notebook in desktop OneNote, and sign out/in to refresh the OneDrive token.

### How do I recover a hacked Microsoft Account when the hacker changed my email alias and password?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/a-hacked-microsoft-account-when-the-hacker-changed-my-email-alias-and-pa
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Account, Authenticator, Microsoft Store, Surface, Edge & Xbox
- Answer: Go immediately to account.live.com/acsr (Microsoft Account Recovery Form) from a previously trusted device and home IP address. Provide old passwords, Xbox Gamertag, Skype ID, billing card last 4 digits, and recent Outlook email subjects. If the primary alias was deleted and replaced, contact Microsoft Support via the Account Compromise guided flow to lock the account while ownership is audited.

### How do I fix Microsoft Authenticator not sending push approval prompts or number matching codes?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-authenticator-not-sending-push-approval-prompts-or-number-matc
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Account, Authenticator, Microsoft Store, Surface, Edge & Xbox
- Answer: Missing prompts occur when Do Not Disturb, iOS Focus, Android Battery Optimization, or VPN blocks push notifications. Enable Notifications and Background App Refresh for Authenticator, set device Date & Time to Automatic, open the app manually and pull down to refresh pending requests, or tap the account to enter the 6-digit TOTP code manually.

### How do I regain access to my Microsoft 365 account if I lost my phone with Microsoft Authenticator?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/how-do-i-regain-access-to-my-microsoft-365-account-if-i-lost-my-phone-wi

- Answer: On the sign-in screen click Sign in another way to use backup SMS, secondary email, or your 25-character recovery code. If you have a Microsoft 365 Work/School account and no backup method, your organization's IT Admin must click Require re-register multifactor authentication in the Microsoft Entra admin center. For personal accounts, initiate the 30-day security info replacement flow at account.microsoft.com/security.

### How do I fix Microsoft Authenticator cloud backup failing to restore accounts on a new iPhone or Android?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-authenticator-cloud-backup-failing-to-restore-accounts-on-a-ne
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Account, Authenticator, Microsoft Store, Surface, Edge & Xbox
- Answer: Authenticator cloud backup only restores personal Microsoft accounts and third-party TOTP codes—and requires iCloud (iOS) or the same personal Microsoft account (Android) BEFORE adding any accounts on the new phone. Uninstall and reinstall Authenticator on the new phone, tap Begin recovery on the very first screen, and re-enroll work/school accounts via QR code at mysignins.microsoft.com.

### How do I fix Microsoft Store error 0x80073D05 or 0x80070002 when downloading or updating apps?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-store-error-0x80073d05-or-0x80070002-when-downloading-or-updat
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Account, Authenticator, Microsoft Store, Surface, Edge & Xbox
- Answer: These codes indicate corrupted Store cache or leftover app folders. Press Win + R, run wsreset.exe, verify Windows Date/Time is set to Automatic, sign out and back into Microsoft Store, and re-register the Store in elevated PowerShell with Get-AppxPackage -AllUsers *WindowsStore* | Foreach {Add-AppxPackage -DisableDevelopmentMode -Register "$($_.InstallLocation)\AppXManifest.xml"}.

### How do I fix Microsoft Store stuck on "Pending" or "Starting download" indefinitely?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-store-stuck-on-pending-or-starting-download-indefinitely
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Account, Authenticator, Microsoft Store, Surface, Edge & Xbox
- Answer: Downloads stall when Delivery Optimization or Windows Update services are paused. Open services.msc and ensure Windows Update, Background Intelligent Transfer Service (BITS), and Microsoft Store Install Service are running, pause all queued downloads in Store > Library, cancel stuck items, and run wsreset.exe.

### How do I fix Xbox App on Windows 11 Gaming Services error 0x80073D26 or 0x8007001F?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/xbox-app-on-windows-11-gaming-services-error-0x80073d26-or-0x8007001f
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Account, Authenticator, Microsoft Store, Surface, Edge & Xbox
- Answer: Corrupted Gaming Services blocks all Game Pass installs on Windows 11. Run PowerShell as Administrator and execute Get-AppxPackage *GamingServices* | Remove-AppxPackage -AllUsers, delete HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\GamingServices and GamingServicesNet in regedit, reboot, and reopen the Xbox App to reinstall Gaming Services cleanly.

### How do I fix Xbox Console error E100, E101, E102, or E105 (System Update / Startup Error)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/xbox-console-error-e100-e101-e102-or-e105-system-update-startup-error
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Account, Authenticator, Microsoft Store, Surface, Edge & Xbox
- Answer: E102/E105 indicates corrupted OS files or a failing internal hard drive/SSD, while E100 signals a Blu-ray drive hardware mismatch during an update. Hold Pair + Eject and tap Power to boot the Xbox Startup Troubleshooter, try Reset this Xbox (Keep my games & apps), and if E102 returns, perform an Offline System Update (OSU1) via a formatted NTFS USB drive.

### How do I fix Xbox Error 0x80a4001a or 0x80a40010 when signing into an Xbox profile?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/xbox-error-0x80a4001a-or-0x80a40010-when-signing-into-an-xbox-profile

### How do I fix Xbox Game Pass subscription active on my account but games still ask me to buy or join?

### How do I fix Xbox Strict NAT Type or "Teredo is unable to qualify" blocking multiplayer party chat?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/xbox-strict-nat-type-or-teredo-is-unable-to-qualify-blocking-multiplayer
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Account, Authenticator, Microsoft Store, Surface, Edge & Xbox
- Answer: Strict NAT / Teredo failure occurs when router UPnP is disabled, dual-NAT exists, or Windows Firewall blocks Teredo tunneling. Enable UPnP on your router (or forward UDP port 3074), confirm Windows Defender Firewall is ON (Teredo requires it), and run netsh interface teredo set state type=enterpriseclient in elevated Command Prompt on Windows.

### How do I fix Microsoft Surface Pro / Surface Laptop not turning on or black screen (battery/firmware lock)?

- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Account, Authenticator, Microsoft Store, Surface, Edge & Xbox
- Answer: Surface devices occasionally lock in low-power UEFI state. Plug in the official Surface Connect charger (verify the tip LED lights solid white), press and hold the Power button for a full 20 seconds until the Surface logo appears and disappears, release, wait 5 seconds, and press Power normally—or try Win + Ctrl + Shift + B if the keyboard backlight turns on.

### How do I fix Microsoft Surface Type Cover keyboard suddenly not detected or typing?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-surface-type-cover-keyboard-suddenly-not-detected-or-typing
- Sub-Topic: Microsoft Account, Authenticator, Microsoft Store, Surface, Edge & Xbox
- Answer: Dirty magnetic pogo pins or a hung Surface UEFI driver cause Type Cover drops. Detach the cover, gently wipe the 6 magnetic gold pins with isopropyl alcohol, reattach, and press Volume Up + Power for 15 seconds to enter UEFI—if the keyboard works inside UEFI, reinstall Surface Type Cover Filter Device in Windows Device Manager; if not, the cover hardware has failed.

### How do I fix Microsoft Surface touchscreen phantom touches or dead zones?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-surface-touchscreen-phantom-touches-or-dead-zones

Unplug third-party power adapters to test, install all Surface Firmware updates under Windows Update > Optional updates, uninstall HID-compliant touch screen in Device Manager, and reboot to reinitialize the Intel Precise Touch driver.

### How do I fix Microsoft Edge using massive RAM/CPU or freezing on multiple tabs?

- Answer: Runaway Edge memory is caused by rogue extensions, disabled Sleeping Tabs, or corrupted GPU cache. Press Shift + Esc inside Edge to identify the offending extension/tab, enable Sleeping Tabs and Efficiency Mode under edge://settings/system, disable Hardware Acceleration if videos stutter, and reset extensions.

### How do I fix Microsoft Family Safety blocking Chrome, games, or screen time even after turning it off?

### How do I fix Microsoft Phone Link not syncing SMS messages, calls, or photos with my Android or iPhone?

### How do I fix iPhone Error 4013, 4005, or 4014 when updating or restoring via Finder or iTunes?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/iphone-error-4013-4005-or-4014-when-updating-or-restoring-via-finder-or
- Sub-Topic: iPhone & iOS
- Answer: Error 4013 indicates a USB communication drop or hardware failure (such as a shorted front earpiece/Face ID sensor flex cable or NAND fault) during firmware flashing. Update Finder/macOS or the Windows Apple Devices app, connect directly with a certified Apple cable (no hubs), force restart into Recovery Mode, and choose Update first. If 4013 repeats across two computers and cables, board-level hardware repair is required.

### How do I fix iPhone Error 1110 during an iOS update when storage is completely full?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/iphone-error-1110-during-an-ios-update-when-storage-is-completely-full
- Sub-Topic: iPhone & iOS
- Answer: Error 1110 happens when iOS runs out of free NAND space while unpacking an update, leaving the iPhone stuck on the Apple logo. Connect to a Mac (Finder) or Windows PC (Apple Devices/iTunes), enter Recovery Mode, and select Update (not Restore) to re-flash iOS via computer without erasing user data. If it fails repeatedly, only a Recovery Mode Restore from backup clears the locked filesystem.

### How do I fix iPhone stuck on "SOS" or "SOS Only" in the status bar with no cellular service?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/iphone-stuck-on-sos-or-sos-only-in-the-status-bar-with-no-cellular-servi
- Sub-Topic: iPhone & iOS
- Answer: "SOS Only" means your iPhone lost registration with your carrier tower while emergency calling remains available via partner towers. Toggle Airplane Mode on for 30 seconds then off, verify Settings > Cellular > Cellular Data and Automatic Network Selection are on, check Settings > General > About for a Carrier Settings Update, re-seat the physical SIM (or toggle eSIM off/on), and contact your carrier if the account or IMEI is suspended.

### How do I fix iPhone "Liquid Detected in Lightning/USB-C Connector" alert when the phone is dry?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/iphone-liquid-detected-in-lightning-usb-c-connector-alert-when-the-phone
- Sub-Topic: iPhone & iOS
- Answer: Moisture sensors trigger from real water ingress OR cheap uncertified car/wall cables leaking voltage across sensing pins. Unplug immediately, tap the phone gently port-down to clear droplets, and let it air-dry for 30–60 minutes (never use rice, hairdryers, or cotton swabs). If completely dry, switch to an official Apple cable or MagSafe/Qi wireless charger to confirm whether a faulty cable triggered a false alert.

### How do I fix rapid iPhone battery drain and overheating immediately after an iOS update?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/rapid-iphone-battery-drain-and-overheating-immediately-after-an-ios-upda
- Sub-Topic: iPhone & iOS
- Answer: Major iOS updates trigger 24–72 hours of background Spotlight indexing, photo library facial scanning, and Apple Intelligence model indexing. Check Settings > Battery to spot runaway third-party apps, toggle off Background App Refresh for non-essential apps, disable unused Location Services set to "Always," update all App Store apps, and restart your iPhone once indexing finishes.

### How do I fix iPhone stuck on "Preparing Update..." or "Unable to Check for Update" on iOS?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/iphone-stuck-on-preparing-update-or-unable-to-check-for-update-on-ios
- Sub-Topic: iPhone & iOS
- Answer: Corrupted partial OTA update files or DNS/VPN interference block iOS verification. Go to Settings > General > iPhone Storage, locate the downloaded iOS Update file, and tap Delete Update. Disable any VPN, switch to a strong Wi-Fi network (with 10+ GB free storage), and re-download—or update directly over USB via Finder/Apple Devices on a computer.

### How do I fix iPhone eSIM "Unable to Activate eSIM" or "No SIM Available" after switching phones?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/iphone-esim-unable-to-activate-esim-or-no-sim-available-after-switching
- Sub-Topic: iPhone & iOS
- Answer: eSIM transfer fails when the carrier locks eSIM provisioning, Wi-Fi drops mid-activation, or the device is carrier-locked. Check Settings > General > About > Carrier Lock (must read No SIM restrictions for another carrier), connect to stable Wi-Fi, update iOS, restart, and request a fresh eSIM QR code or Quick Transfer push from your carrier's app or support desk.

### How do I fix iPhone "Charging on Hold: Charging will resume when iPhone returns to normal temperature"?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/iphone-charging-on-hold-charging-will-resume-when-iphone-returns-to-norm
- Sub-Topic: iPhone & iOS
- Answer: iOS intentionally pauses charging at 80% when internal battery temperatures exceed safe thermal limits (often from fast-charging in sunlight, thick cases, or gaming while plugged in). Remove thick cases, move the iPhone out of direct heat/car dashboards, stop heavy camera/gaming apps, and let it cool naturally—never place an iPhone in a freezer or refrigerator, which causes internal condensation.

### How do I fix iPhone Optimized Battery Charging or 80% Charge Limit stopping battery at 80%?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/iphone-optimized-battery-charging-or-80-charge-limit-stopping-battery-at
- Sub-Topic: iPhone & iOS
- Answer: On iPhone 15/16 and newer, an explicit Charge Limit (80%–95%) caps every charge unless raised. Open Settings > Battery > Charging and slide the Charge Limit back to 100% (or disable Optimized Battery Charging if your schedule varies). Note that Clean Energy Charging also delays charging past 80% in the US unless toggled off.

### How do I fix iPhone Apple CarPlay not connecting or constantly disconnecting in the car?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/iphone-apple-carplay-not-connecting-or-constantly-disconnecting-in-the-c
- Sub-Topic: iPhone & iOS
- Answer: CarPlay requires Siri to be enabled and fails frequently due to worn USB cables or stale Bluetooth handshakes. Enable Settings > Apple Intelligence & Siri, open Settings > General > CarPlay > [Your Car] > Forget This Car, remove the iPhone from the vehicle head unit's Bluetooth list, reboot the infotainment screen, and reconnect using a short MFi-certified USB data cable.

### How do I fix iPhone AirDrop not finding nearby devices or stuck on "Waiting..."?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/iphone-airdrop-not-finding-nearby-devices-or-stuck-on-waiting
- Sub-Topic: iPhone & iOS
- Answer: AirDrop requires Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and unlocked screens on both devices—and iOS defaults receiving to Contacts Only (or auto-reverts Everyone after 10 minutes). Disable Personal Hotspot and any active VPN, open Settings > General > AirDrop and select Everyone for 10 Minutes, ensure both devices aren't blocked by Screen Time Content & Privacy Restrictions, and toggle Wi-Fi/Bluetooth off and on.

### How do I fix iPhone green screen, vertical green line, or pink screen after an iOS update or drop?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/iphone-green-screen-vertical-green-line-or-pink-screen-after-an-ios-upda
- Sub-Topic: iPhone & iOS
- Answer: A persistent solid green/pink screen or vertical line indicates OLED display flex/driver IC degradation or loose internal display connectors. Perform a Force Restart (Volume Up, Volume Down, hold Side button 15 seconds) and check if the line appears in a screenshot (if absent in screenshots, it is hardware). Back up immediately via iCloud/computer and schedule an Apple OLED display replacement.

### How do I fix iPhone "Unavailable" or "Security Lockout" screen after entering the wrong passcode too many times?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/iphone-unavailable-or-security-lockout-screen-after-entering-the-wrong-p
- Sub-Topic: iPhone & iOS
- Answer: After 10 failed passcodes, iOS permanently locks the device for security. On iOS 17+, tap Forgot Passcode? in the bottom-right corner and select Start iPhone Reset (requires your Apple Account password and internet; or Enter Previous Passcode within 72 hours of a passcode change). Otherwise, connect to a computer in Recovery Mode to erase and restore from an iCloud/computer backup.

### How do I fix iPhone camera showing a black screen, blurry focus, or shaking/buzzing lens?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/iphone-camera-showing-a-black-screen-blurry-focus-or-shaking-buzzing-len
- Sub-Topic: iPhone & iOS
- Answer: A buzzing or jittering rear camera indicates a damaged Optical Image Stabilization (OIS) motor (commonly from motorcycle handlebar vibrations). First remove magnetic/metal cases that interfere with OIS magnets, force-close the Camera app, toggle off Settings > Camera > Preserve Settings, and force-restart. If focus still vibrates or stays black across third-party apps, the rear camera module requires replacement.

### How do I fix iPhone speaker muffled, crackling, or callers unable to hear me on regular calls?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/iphone-speaker-muffled-crackling-or-callers-unable-to-hear-me-on-regular
- Sub-Topic: iPhone & iOS
- Answer: Lint packed inside the earpiece mesh or bottom microphone grille accounts for most muffled audio. Gently brush the speaker/mic mesh with a dry soft-bristle brush (never compressed air or pins), test recording a Voice Memo (tests bottom mic) and a front camera video (tests top mic) to isolate hardware failure, and toggle Settings > Accessibility > Audio & Visual > Phone Noise Cancellation / Voice Isolation during calls.

### How do I fix iPhone iMessage sending green SMS bubbles instead of blue iMessages?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/iphone-imessage-sending-green-sms-bubbles-instead-of-blue-imessages
- Sub-Topic: iPhone & iOS
- Answer: Green bubbles occur when your phone number de-registers from iMessage, cellular/Wi-Fi drops, or the recipient switched away from iPhone. Go to Settings > Apps > Messages, toggle iMessage off and on, tap Send & Receive to verify your phone number is checked (not just your email), check apple.com/support/systemstatus, and enable RCS Messaging for rich Android messaging.

### How do I fix iPhone "Not Delivered" red exclamation mark on SMS/MMS picture messages to Android users?

### How do I fix iPhone Personal Hotspot missing, grayed out, or laptop unable to connect?

If laptops see the hotspot but drop immediately, enable Maximize Compatibility under Settings > Personal Hotspot (forces 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi) and keep the Hotspot screen open while connecting.

### How do I fix iPhone Visual Voicemail not loading or showing "Call Voicemail" instead of transcripts?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/iphone-visual-voicemail-not-loading-or-showing-call-voicemail-instead-of
- Sub-Topic: iPhone & iOS
- Answer: Visual Voicemail requires an active cellular data connection and carrier provisioning. Turn Wi-Fi off temporarily, call your voicemail box (1) to confirm it's initialized, toggle Live Voicemail in Settings > Apps > Phone, reset network settings (Settings > General > Transfer or Reset iPhone > Reset > Reset Network Settings), or ask your carrier to reprovision Visual Voicemail on your line.

### How do I fix iPhone stuck in Headphone Mode with no sound coming from the built-in speakers?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/iphone-stuck-in-headphone-mode-with-no-sound-coming-from-the-built-in-sp
- Sub-Topic: iPhone & iOS
- Answer: Stuck Headphone Mode happens when a Bluetooth audio device remains connected silently or lint bridges pins inside the charging/audio port. Swipe down Control Center, tap the AirPlay audio icon in the media widget, and switch output back to iPhone. Turn Bluetooth off to test, clean the port gently with a wooden toothpick, and force-restart.

### How do I fix iPhone Photos showing an exclamation mark (!) and failing to load full resolution?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/iphone-photos-showing-an-exclamation-mark-and-failing-to-load-full-resol
- Sub-Topic: iPhone & iOS
- Answer: The exclamation mark means Optimize iPhone Storage offloaded the full-resolution file to iCloud Photos, and the iPhone cannot download it due to low local storage, Low Data Mode, or paused iCloud sync. Free at least 3–5 GB on the iPhone, connect to unmetered Wi-Fi, disable Low Power Mode and Low Data Mode, and confirm the photo exists at icloud.com/photos.

### How do I fix iPhone "Stolen Device Protection" delaying Face ID, Passcode, or Apple Account changes by 1 hour?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/iphone-stolen-device-protection-delaying-face-id-passcode-or-apple-accou
- Sub-Topic: iPhone & iOS
- Answer: Stolen Device Protection intentionally enforces a 1-hour Security Delay when you are away from Significant Locations (home/work) and requires Face ID/Touch ID with no passcode fallback. Wait out the 1-hour timer to complete the change, or return to a familiar location (with Settings > Privacy & Security > Location Services > System Services > Significant Locations enabled) to adjust it under Settings > Face ID & Passcode > Stolen Device Protection.

### How do I fix iPhone "Important Battery Message / Unknown Part" warning after battery or screen repair?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/iphone-important-battery-message-unknown-part-warning-after-battery-or-s
- Sub-Topic: iPhone & iOS
- Answer: iOS displays "Unknown Part" when a third-party/non-genuine battery or display is installed, or an authentic Apple part was not calibrated via Repair Assistant. On iOS 18+ (iPhone 12 and newer), open Settings > General > About > Parts and Service History and tap Restart and Finish Repair if a genuine Apple part was used; third-party aftermarket parts permanently display the alert without blocking core charging.

### How do I fix iPhone screen dimming automatically even with Auto-Brightness turned off?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/iphone-screen-dimming-automatically-even-with-auto-brightness-turned-off
- Sub-Topic: iPhone & iOS
- Answer: Sudden dimming despite Auto-Brightness being off is caused by thermal throttling (the iPhone reduces peak nits to protect the OLED panel and battery when warm) or Reduce White Point / Attention Aware Features. Close heat-generating apps/direct sunlight exposure, and check Settings > Accessibility > Display & Text Size to ensure Auto-Brightness and Reduce White Point are both off.

### How do I fix iPhone FaceTime audio/video freezing, "Waiting for Activation," or poor call quality?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/iphone-facetime-audio-video-freezing-waiting-for-activation-or-poor-call
- Sub-Topic: iPhone & iOS
- Answer: Verify accurate Date & Time (Settings > General > Date & Time > Set Automatically), ensure Settings > Apps > FaceTime is toggled on and shows your number/Apple ID checked, disable VPNs that throttle UDP video streams, test on Wi-Fi vs. 5G, and toggle off Mic Mode: Voice Isolation if audio cuts out.

### How do I fix iPhone Safari "Cannot Open Page Because Too Many Redirects Occurred" or blank pages?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/iphone-safari-cannot-open-page-because-too-many-redirects-occurred-or-bl
- Sub-Topic: iPhone & iOS
- Answer: Corrupted cookies, expired HSTS entries, or iCloud Private Relay / ad-blocker rules trigger Safari redirect loops. Go to Settings > Apps > Safari > Clear History and Website Data, disable third-party Content Blockers under Safari > Extensions, and toggle off iCloud Private Relay under Settings > [Your Name] > iCloud to test.

### How do I fix iPhone "Transfer Directly from iPhone" Quick Start freezing on "Time Remaining: Estimating..."?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/iphone-transfer-directly-from-iphone-quick-start-freezing-on-time-remain
- Sub-Topic: iPhone & iOS
- Answer: Quick Start stalls when the two iPhones run mismatched iOS versions or have weak peer-to-peer Wi-Fi.
