First-time direct deposits often take 1–2 pay cycles to transition from paper check; confirm with HR/payroll that the routing number wasn't rejected, and note that early payday (up to 2 days early) depends on when your employer submits the ACH file.

### How do I fix PayPal Savings (Synchrony Bank) transfer stuck or unable to open a Savings account?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/paypal-savings-synchrony-bank-transfer-stuck-or-unable-to-open-a-savings
- Sub-Topic: Transfers, Withdrawals, Linked Bank/Card Declines & Negative Balances
- Answer: PayPal Savings requires a verified US PayPal Balance account (with SSN confirmed), active 2FA, and zero account limitations. Transfers between PayPal Savings and your PayPal Balance are typically instant, whereas external bank transfers must route through your PayPal Balance first. Contact Synchrony/PayPal Savings support directly if KYC identity mismatch blocks onboarding.

### I paid a scammer using PayPal "Friends and Family"—can I get my money back?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/i-paid-a-scammer-using-paypal-friends-and-family-can-i-get-my-money-back
- Sub-Topic: Disputes, Chargebacks, Buyer/Seller Protection & Scams
- Answer: PayPal Friends and Family (F&F) carries zero Buyer Protection, so PayPal almost always denies "Item Not Received" claims on F&F transfers. Your two realistic options are: (1) if you did NOT authorize the transfer (hacked account), immediately report an Unauthorized Transaction in PayPal Resolution Center; (2) if you funded the F&F payment with a credit card or bank debit card, call your card issuer immediately to ask about filing a fraud/scam dispute (note: a bank chargeback may create a negative balance on PayPal).

### How do I open and win a PayPal "Item Not Received" (INR) or "Significantly Not As Described" (SNAD) dispute?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/and-win-a-paypal-item-not-received-inr-or-significantly-not-as-described
- Sub-Topic: Disputes, Chargebacks, Buyer/Seller Protection & Scams
- Answer: You have 180 days from the payment date to open a dispute in Resolution Center > Report a Problem (Goods & Services only). Upload clear screenshots of the original listing, messages with the seller, unboxing photos showing defects/counterfeits, and escalate the dispute to a Claim within 20 days before it automatically closes permanently.

### How do I beat the PayPal "Fake Tracking Number" scam where tracking says Delivered to my ZIP code?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/the-paypal-fake-tracking-number-scam-where-tracking-says-delivered-to-my
- Sub-Topic: Disputes, Chargebacks, Buyer/Seller Protection & Scams
- Answer: Scammers ship an empty envelope to a random address in your same ZIP code so automated PayPal systems see "Delivered" and auto-close your INR claim. Immediately go to your local post office/UPS/FedEx and obtain an official printed letter on carrier letterhead confirming the tracking number's actual delivery street address and package weight do not match your address/item, then appeal the closed claim via PayPal phone support and upload that carrier letter.

### How do I spot and cancel a fake PayPal Invoice scam (Geek Squad, Norton, McAfee, Crypto invoice)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/and-cancel-a-fake-paypal-invoice-scam-geek-squad-norton-mcafee-crypto-in
- Sub-Topic: Disputes, Chargebacks, Buyer/Seller Protection & Scams
- Answer: Scammers abuse PayPal's legitimate Request Money / Invoicing tool to send real emails from service@paypal.com claiming you owe $499 for Norton/McAfee/Bitcoin—with a fake "call to cancel" phone number in the Seller Note. Never call the number in the note and never click Pay. Log directly into paypal.com, open the fake invoice, click Report this invoice or Cancel/Ignore—no money has been taken from your account.

### How do I spot the "PayPal Business Account Upgrade Fee" scam when selling on Facebook Marketplace?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/the-paypal-business-account-upgrade-fee-scam-when-selling-on-facebook-ma
- Sub-Topic: Disputes, Chargebacks, Buyer/Seller Protection & Scams
- Answer: A scammer claims they sent you money, then sends a fake spoofed email claiming your account must be "upgraded to a Business Account" by having the buyer send an extra $300 that you must refund back via Zelle/PayPal. PayPal NEVER charges a fee or requires extra money to "expand/upgrade" an account to receive funds. Always verify payments exclusively inside your live paypal.com Activity—never trust emails.

### How do I dispute an unauthorized PayPal transaction when my account was hacked?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/an-unauthorized-paypal-transaction-when-my-account-was-hacked
- Sub-Topic: Disputes, Chargebacks, Buyer/Seller Protection & Scams
- Answer: Immediately change your PayPal password, enable an Authenticator App (2FA), revoke unknown devices/sessions under Settings > Security, remove rogue linked banks/cards, and go to Resolution Center > Report a Problem > Report unauthorized activity for every fraudulent transaction within 60 days so PayPal's Zero Liability Unauthorized Transaction team investigates IP/device logs and refunds you.

### Why did PayPal deny my "Unauthorized Transaction" claim saying it was "consistent with your account history"?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/paypal-deny-my-unauthorized-transaction-claim-saying-it-was-consistent-w
- Sub-Topic: Disputes, Chargebacks, Buyer/Seller Protection & Scams
- Answer: Automated checks reject unauthorized claims if the hacker accessed your computer via remote-access malware/AnyDesk, used a stolen browser session cookie, or used your own Wi-Fi/device. Call PayPal Fraud Support directly to request a human appeal, file a local police report / FTC Identity Theft report (identitytheft.gov), attach the report number to your appeal, and notify your bank/card issuer.

### As a seller, how do I win a PayPal Buyer Chargeback (Credit Card Bank Dispute) under Seller Protection?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/as-a-seller-how-do-i-win-a-paypal-buyer-chargeback-credit-card-bank-disp
- Sub-Topic: Disputes, Chargebacks, Buyer/Seller Protection & Scams
- Answer: Respond inside Resolution Center within the strict 10-day deadline. To qualify for PayPal Seller Protection, submit: (1) online viewable tracking showing Delivered to the exact shipping address on the PayPal Transaction Details page, (2) Signature Confirmation for orders of $750+, and (3) proof of shipment before the dispute opened. Never ship to a different address requested via email/DM.

### Why does PayPal charge sellers a $20 Chargeback Fee even if the seller wins or refunds?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/paypal-charge-sellers-a-20-chargeback-fee-even-if-the-seller-wins-or-ref
- Sub-Topic: Disputes, Chargebacks, Buyer/Seller Protection & Scams
- Answer: When a buyer files a dispute directly with their credit card issuer (an external chargeback) rather than through PayPal's Resolution Center, card networks charge PayPal a dispute processing fee that PayPal passes to the merchant ($20 USD) unless the transaction qualifies in full for PayPal Seller Protection. Issuing a prompt refund when a buyer messages you prevents costly chargeback fees.

### How do I cancel a recurring PayPal Automatic Payment / Preapproved Subscription so a merchant stops charging me?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/a-recurring-paypal-automatic-payment-preapproved-subscription-so-a-merch
- Sub-Topic: Disputes, Chargebacks, Buyer/Seller Protection & Scams
- Answer: Log into paypal.com, click Settings (gear) > Payments > Automatic payments, select the merchant from the left list, and click Cancel (confirming status changes to Inactive). Note that canceling an automatic billing agreement stops *future* charges—you must still cancel with the merchant or dispute unauthorized past charges separately.

### How do I handle a PayPal "Return for Refund" claim when return shipping costs more than the item (overseas seller)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/a-paypal-return-for-refund-claim-when-return-shipping-costs-more-than-th
- Sub-Topic: Disputes, Chargebacks, Buyer/Seller Protection & Scams
- Answer: Under PayPal Buyer Protection, buyers are normally responsible for return shipping costs on SNAD claims even back to overseas addresses—unless the item is proven counterfeit (which cannot legally be mailed). Contact PayPal Support with written evidence if the seller provided a fake/undeliverable return address or counterfeit goods; always ship returns with full online tracking + signature for items over $750.

### How do I reopen a PayPal dispute that was accidentally closed or timed out after 20 days?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/a-paypal-dispute-that-was-accidentally-closed-or-timed-out-after-20-days
- Sub-Topic: Disputes, Chargebacks, Buyer/Seller Protection & Scams
- Answer: Once a PayPal dispute is closed manually by the buyer or expires after 20 days without being escalated to a Claim, PayPal's system cannot reopen it. Never close a dispute based on a seller's promise to "refund once you close the case"—that is a classic scam. If it was closed due to a technical glitch or new evidence on a decided *claim*, you have 10 days to file an Appeal in the Resolution Center.

### Why did PayPal remove Buyer Protection on a digital gift card, vehicle, or real estate purchase?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/paypal-remove-buyer-protection-on-a-digital-gift-card-vehicle-or-real-es
- Sub-Topic: Disputes, Chargebacks, Buyer/Seller Protection & Scams
- Answer: PayPal's Buyer Protection policy explicitly excludes motorized vehicles, real estate, industrial machinery, gift cards/prepaid cash equivalents, crowdfunding/donations, custom-made items (SNAD), and anything picked up in person. Always use escrow or a credit card with strong direct chargeback rights for those categories.

### How do I report a phishing email pretending to be from PayPal (service@paypal.com spoof)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/a-phishing-email-pretending-to-be-from-paypal-service-paypal-com-spoof
- Sub-Topic: Disputes, Chargebacks, Buyer/Seller Protection & Scams
- Answer: Forward the suspicious email intact to phishing@paypal.com and delete it. Never click links inside urgent "Account Suspended" or "Confirm Unusual Activity" emails—always type paypal.com manually into your browser and check your Message Center or Resolution Center directly.

### What happens when a PayPal buyer claims "Item Not As Described" and returns an empty box or brick?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/when-a-paypal-buyer-claims-item-not-as-described-and-returns-an-empty-bo
- Sub-Topic: Disputes, Chargebacks, Buyer/Seller Protection & Scams
- Answer: Record clear photos/video of the sealed return parcel label, carrier-stamped package weight on the shipping receipt, and the contents upon opening. Immediately appeal the claim inside Resolution Center within 10 days, submit a local police report / IC3.gov report documenting mail fraud, and call PayPal Merchant Support to escalate to the Claims Appeals team.

### Why was my PayPal "Pay in 4" application declined even though I have good credit?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/why-was-my-paypal-pay-in-4-application-declined-even-though-i-have-good
- Sub-Topic: Pay in 4, PayPal Credit, Crypto, Venmo Sync, 1099-K Taxes & Login/2FA Lockouts
- Answer: PayPal Pay in 4 evaluates real-time internal risk signals—not just your FICO score—including account age, linked backup debit card validity, recent unsettled Pay in 4 plans, purchase amount (eligible $30–$1,500), and merchant category. Check your PayPal Message Center for the exact Adverse Action notice (support agents cannot manually override automated declines) and confirm your primary debit card isn't expiring soon.

### Why is there a pending PayPal Pay in 4 charge on my bank account when my checkout failed or was canceled?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/there-a-pending-paypal-pay-in-4-charge-on-my-bank-account-when-my-checko
- Sub-Topic: Pay in 4, PayPal Credit, Crypto, Venmo Sync, 1099-K Taxes & Login/2FA Lockouts
- Answer: PayPal places a temporary 25% down-payment authorization when you click Pay in 4; if the merchant checkout times out or cancels, that authorization automatically expires and drops off your bank account within 72 hours to 7 business days without creating a loan.

### How do I pay off PayPal Credit (Synchrony Bank) or fix a PayPal Credit promotional 6-month 0% deferred interest trap?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/off-paypal-credit-synchrony-bank-or-fix-a-paypal-credit-promotional-6-mo
- Sub-Topic: Pay in 4, PayPal Credit, Crypto, Venmo Sync, 1099-K Taxes & Login/2FA Lockouts
- Answer: PayPal Credit's "No Interest if Paid in Full in 6 Months" on purchases $149+ is deferred interest—leaving even $1 unpaid past the promo expiration date triggers retroactive ~31% APR interest from Day 1. Open PayPal Credit > Statements to check each promo's exact expiration date, make manual extra payments ahead of the cutoff, and confirm Synchrony allocates payments toward expiring promos first.

### Why did PayPal send me a Form 1099-K for selling personal stuff or casual transfers?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/paypal-send-me-a-form-1099-k-for-selling-personal-stuff-or-casual-transf
- Sub-Topic: Pay in 4, PayPal Credit, Crypto, Venmo Sync, 1099-K Taxes & Login/2FA Lockouts
- Answer: Under IRS and state reporting laws, PayPal must issue Form 1099-K when gross Goods & Services payments cross applicable federal or state thresholds (some states like MA, VT, VA, MD enforce $600). PayPal reports *gross* receipts before fees or original purchase cost. Selling used personal items at a loss is NOT taxable income—report the 1099-K on Schedule 1 / Form 8949 with offsetting cost basis so you aren't double-taxed.

### How do I fix PayPal holding 24% Backup Withholding tax on my incoming payments?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/paypal-holding-24-backup-withholding-tax-on-my-incoming-payments
- Sub-Topic: Pay in 4, PayPal Credit, Crypto, Venmo Sync, 1099-K Taxes & Login/2FA Lockouts
- Answer: PayPal is legally required by the IRS to withhold 24% Backup Withholding when you cross reporting thresholds without a confirmed SSN/EIN/ITIN on file (or if your TIN fails IRS name-match validation). Log in, submit your exact IRS-matching Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) under the Resolution Center tax alert, and claim any already-withheld 24% amounts back as tax credits when filing your IRS return using Form 1099-K.

### How do I fix PayPal stuck in an infinite "Security Check / Captcha" login loop?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/paypal-stuck-in-an-infinite-security-check-captcha-login-loop
- Sub-Topic: Pay in 4, PayPal Credit, Crypto, Venmo Sync, 1099-K Taxes & Login/2FA Lockouts
- Answer: Endless captcha or MFA redirect loops stem from VPNs, strict browser privacy blockers (Brave Shields/uBlock), stale cookies, or temporary IP throttling. Disable all ad blockers and VPNs, clear paypal.com cookies (or open a fresh Chrome Incognito window), switch from Wi-Fi to mobile cellular data, and wait 24 hours if you triggered a velocity lockout by retrying rapidly.

### How do I get back into my PayPal account if I changed my phone number and can't receive 2FA SMS codes?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/back-into-my-paypal-account-if-i-changed-my-phone-number-and-can-t-recei
- Sub-Topic: Pay in 4, PayPal Credit, Crypto, Venmo Sync, 1099-K Taxes & Login/2FA Lockouts
- Answer: Click Try another way on the 2FA screen to use backup security questions, email OTP, or your Authenticator app. If SMS was your only method, call PayPal Customer Service as a guest (Contact > Call us > Call as a guest) and verify identity via your linked bank/card last 4 digits and ID so an agent can temporarily disable the old 2FA phone number.

### How do I fix PayPal "We can't confirm it's you" error when trying to reset my password?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/paypal-we-can-t-confirm-it-s-you-error-when-trying-to-reset-my-password
- Sub-Topic: Pay in 4, PayPal Credit, Crypto, Venmo Sync, 1099-K Taxes & Login/2FA Lockouts
- Answer: PayPal's automated trust model blocks password resets initiated from brand-new browsers, VPNs, or unfamiliar locations. Attempt the reset from a previously trusted phone/laptop connected to your home internet IP (off VPN). If it still blocks you, use the PayPal mobile app or call PayPal Guest Support directly with your linked card/bank details ready.

### How do I fix PayPal Crypto (Bitcoin, Ethereum, PYUSD) external wallet transfer disabled or failing?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/paypal-crypto-bitcoin-ethereum-pyusd-external-wallet-transfer-disabled-o
- Sub-Topic: Pay in 4, PayPal Credit, Crypto, Venmo Sync, 1099-K Taxes & Login/2FA Lockouts
- Answer: External crypto transfers require full KYC Identity Verification, active Two-Factor Authentication (2FA), and an eligible personal PayPal account (not available in certain jurisdictions like Hawaii or on Business accounts). Verify your weekly crypto transfer limit ($25,000/week max) and confirm the destination wallet address format matches the exact blockchain network (e.g., ERC-20 for ETH/PYUSD).

### Why can't I transfer money directly between PayPal and Venmo?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/i-transfer-money-directly-between-paypal-and-venmo
- Sub-Topic: Pay in 4, PayPal Credit, Crypto, Venmo Sync, 1099-K Taxes & Login/2FA Lockouts
- Answer: Although PayPal owns Venmo, they operate as separate ecosystems—you cannot natively send funds directly from a PayPal Balance to a Venmo Balance without an intermediary (except via PayPal/Venmo's evolving interoperability P2P search where rolled out). The fastest zero-fee workaround is withdrawing from PayPal to your shared checking bank account (or debit card) and funding Venmo from that same bank.

### How do I fix PayPal Checkout Error 10486 ("This transaction couldn't be completed — please redirect your customer to PayPal")?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/paypal-checkout-error-10486-this-transaction-couldn-t-be-completed-pleas
- Sub-Topic: Pay in 4, PayPal Credit, Crypto, Venmo Sync, 1099-K Taxes & Login/2FA Lockouts
- Answer: Error 10486 means the buyer's underlying funding source inside PayPal was declined (insufficient funds, bank fraud block, or expired card). For buyers, open PayPal Wallet, select a different funded card/bank, and retry checkout. For merchants using PayPal APIs, properly handle 10486 by redirecting the buyer back to the PayPal approval URL to pick an alternate funding source.

### How do I fix PayPal Checkout Error 10755 or "Unsupported Currency" on international orders?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/paypal-checkout-error-10755-or-unsupported-currency-on-international-ord
- Sub-Topic: Pay in 4, PayPal Credit, Crypto, Venmo Sync, 1099-K Taxes & Login/2FA Lockouts
- Answer: Error 10755 happens when a merchant's checkout requests a currency unsupported by PayPal or blocked in the seller's Payment Receiving Preferences. Sellers should go to Account Settings > Payment Preferences > Block Payments and allow currency conversion, while buyers should confirm their checkout currency matches an accepted PayPal currency (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, etc.).

### How do I fix PayPal Payflow / Braintree / WooCommerce webhook not marking orders as Paid?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/paypal-payflow-braintree-woocommerce-webhook-not-marking-orders-as-paid
- Sub-Topic: Pay in 4, PayPal Credit, Crypto, Venmo Sync, 1099-K Taxes & Login/2FA Lockouts
- Answer: Unpaid/Pending WooCommerce orders occur when IPN/Webhook endpoints are blocked by Cloudflare/WAF firewalls, SSL certificates fail, or PayPal Standard IPN URLs are outdated. Migrate from deprecated PayPal Standard to PayPal Payments (REST API), re-register webhooks inside the plugin settings, and whitelist PayPal's IPN/Webhook user-agents in Cloudflare/Wordfence.

### How do I fix PayPal "You can't send money to yourself" or unable to send between two household accounts?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/paypal-you-can-t-send-money-to-yourself-or-unable-to-send-between-two-ho
- Sub-Topic: Pay in 4, PayPal Credit, Crypto, Venmo Sync, 1099-K Taxes & Login/2FA Lockouts
- Answer: PayPal blocks transfers between accounts sharing the same bank account, debit card, or identical owner identity. Ensure each household member uses their own unique email, phone number, and separate funding card, and never try to move money between your own Personal and Business accounts to manufacture credit card points (which violates PayPal's Cash Advance policy).

### How do I fix PayPal QR Code or PayPal.Me link not working or showing "Profile Unavailable"?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/paypal-qr-code-or-paypal-me-link-not-working-or-showing-profile-unavaila
- Sub-Topic: Pay in 4, PayPal Credit, Crypto, Venmo Sync, 1099-K Taxes & Login/2FA Lockouts
- Answer: PayPal.Me links deactivate if your account is limited, unverified, or switched off under privacy settings. Go to Settings > Account > PayPal.Me, verify your handle is toggled Active, confirm your email address is verified, and note that PayPal.Me links cannot be renamed once created (only turned off).

### How do I fix PayPal Debit Card declined at a store or ATM when my PayPal Balance has money?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/paypal-debit-card-declined-at-a-store-or-atm-when-my-paypal-balance-has
- Sub-Topic: Pay in 4, PayPal Credit, Crypto, Venmo Sync, 1099-K Taxes & Login/2FA Lockouts
- Answer: Check whether the card is temporarily Locked in the PayPal app (Wallet > PayPal Debit Card), verify you haven't exceeded daily spending ($3,000) or ATM withdrawal ($400) limits, confirm your 4-digit PIN, and ensure Backup Funding is configured if a purchase exceeds your exact available PayPal Balance (note: PayPal Debit draws from PayPal Balance, not Savings).

### How do I change my legal name on PayPal after marriage or fixing a typo?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/my-legal-name-on-paypal-after-marriage-or-fixing-a-typo
- Sub-Topic: Pay in 4, PayPal Credit, Crypto, Venmo Sync, 1099-K Taxes & Login/2FA Lockouts
- Answer: PayPal allows typo fixes of up to 2 characters directly, while legal name changes (marriage/divorce/court order) require document verification. Go to Settings > Account > Change your name, select Legal name change, upload a clear photo of your updated government ID plus marriage certificate/court decree, and wait 2–5 business days for approval.

### Why does PayPal say "This recipient is currently unable to receive money"?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/paypal-say-this-recipient-is-currently-unable-to-receive-money
- Sub-Topic: Pay in 4, PayPal Credit, Crypto, Venmo Sync, 1099-K Taxes & Login/2FA Lockouts
- Answer: This error is strictly on the recipient's side: their account is limited, unverified, in a receive-only restricted country, or hasn't confirmed their email address. You cannot fix this from your sender account—notify the recipient to check their own PayPal Resolution Center and confirm their email/KYC status.

### How do I download monthly PayPal Activity statements for a mortgage lender or accountant?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/monthly-paypal-activity-statements-for-a-mortgage-lender-or-accountant
- Sub-Topic: Pay in 4, PayPal Credit, Crypto, Venmo Sync, 1099-K Taxes & Login/2FA Lockouts
- Answer: Log into paypal.com on a desktop browser (not the mobile app), go to Activity > Statements > Standard (or Custom), select the exact month or date range, click Download PDF (for lenders) or CSV (for QuickBooks/tax accountants), and allow a few minutes for large annual reports to compile.

### How do I reach a real human at PayPal Customer Support instead of the automated assistant?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/a-real-human-at-paypal-customer-support-instead-of-the-automated-assista
- Sub-Topic: Pay in 4, PayPal Credit, Crypto, Venmo Sync, 1099-K Taxes & Login/2FA Lockouts
- Answer: Log into paypal.com, click Help > Contact Us > Message Us, type "Speak to an agent" twice when prompted by the bot to enter the live human messaging queue, OR click Call Us to generate your 6-digit one-time passcode (1-888-221-1161 in the US) and say "Representative" at the voice prompt.

## Amazon, Prime & Devices (80 Guides)
Category Hub: https://answerdesk.online/guides/category/amazon

### How do I unlock an Amazon account placed "On Hold" for unusual payment or login activity?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/an-amazon-account-placed-on-hold-for-unusual-payment-or-login-activity
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Account Locked, On Hold, OTP/2FA, Hacked Account & Verification Loops
- Answer: Amazon places automated holds when you add a new card, redeem a large gift card, or log in over a VPN. Sign in on a desktop browser (off VPN) to view the exact Account On Hold upload prompt, submit a recent PDF billing statement clearly showing your full name, billing address, and the last 4 digits of the payment card (masking full card numbers), and wait 24–72 hours for Account Expert review.

### How do I fix Amazon OTP (One-Time Password) verification code not arriving by SMS or email?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-otp-one-time-password-verification-code-not-arriving-by-sms-or-em
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Account Locked, On Hold, OTP/2FA, Hacked Account & Verification Loops
- Answer: Delayed or missing Amazon OTPs stem from carrier short-code blocks, full spam folders, or triggering rate limits by clicking Resend repeatedly. Wait 10 minutes before retrying, check Spam/Promotions for account-update@amazon.com, text HELP to Amazon's short code (262966) to confirm your carrier isn't blocking short codes, or tap Didn't receive the OTP? to switch to voice call / authenticator app.

### How do I recover my Amazon account if I lost my old phone number and can't pass 2-Step Verification (2SV)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/my-amazon-account-if-i-lost-my-old-phone-number-and-can-t-pass-2-step-ve
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Account Locked, On Hold, OTP/2FA, Hacked Account & Verification Loops
- Answer: Visit amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html and search Two-Step Verification Account Recovery. Sign in with your email and password, click Didn't receive the OTP? > Account Recovery, upload a clear photo of your government-issued ID matching your account name (covering sensitive ID numbers except name/photo), and wait 24–48 hours for Amazon to disable 2SV so you can log in and update your phone number.

### How do I recover a hacked Amazon account where the hacker ordered items or archived orders?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/a-hacked-amazon-account-where-the-hacker-ordered-items-or-archived-order
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Account Locked, On Hold, OTP/2FA, Hacked Account & Verification Loops
- Answer: Immediately reset your Amazon password AND your email account's password (hackers often use compromised email passwords), enable an Authenticator App under Login & Security > 2-Step Verification, click Manage > Sign out everywhere to kill active sessions, check Your Account > Archived Orders (hackers hide stolen purchases there!), cancel pending orders, and contact Amazon Customer Service + your card issuer to reverse unauthorized charges.

### Why did Amazon close my account for "excessive returns" or "Concessions Abuse" and can I appeal?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-close-my-account-for-excessive-returns-or-concessions-abuse-and-c
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Account Locked, On Hold, OTP/2FA, Hacked Account & Verification Loops
- Answer: Amazon's OFM (Order Fulfillment & Concessions) team flags accounts with high return ratios, frequent "Delivered Not Received" refunds, or returned items mismatched from serial numbers. Reply directly to the ofm@amazon.com notice with calm, factual order IDs and carrier drop-off receipts explaining legitimate defects or porch theft—avoid opening duplicate accounts using the same card/address, which triggers automatic closure.

### How do I fix Amazon login stuck in an infinite puzzle/captcha or "Important Message: Enter the characters you see" loop?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-login-stuck-in-an-infinite-puzzle-captcha-or-important-message-en
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Account Locked, On Hold, OTP/2FA, Hacked Account & Verification Loops
- Answer: Captcha loops trigger from browser extensions, aggressive ad/tracker blockers, VPN IP ranges, or corrupted session cookies. Disable your VPN and ad-blocker on amazon.com, clear amazon.com cookies and cache, test in a clean Incognito window or the official Amazon Shopping app on mobile data, and avoid automated price-tracker extensions.

### How do I fix "We cannot find an account with that email address" when my Amazon account existed yesterday?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/we-cannot-find-an-account-with-that-email-address-when-my-amazon-account
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Account Locked, On Hold, OTP/2FA, Hacked Account & Verification Loops
- Answer: This occurs when you signed up with a phone number only, accidentally typed a typo email at creation, switched Amazon regional storefronts (e.g., amazon.co.uk vs amazon.com), OR a hacker changed your registered login email. Search your inbox for past Amazon order emails to confirm the exact email/domain, try signing in with your mobile phone number, and contact Amazon Account Change Support immediately if you received an unauthorized "Email address updated" alert.

### How do I fix Amazon "Your payment revision is needed" loop even though my credit card is valid?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-your-payment-revision-is-needed-loop-even-though-my-credit-card-i
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Account Locked, On Hold, OTP/2FA, Hacked Account & Verification Loops
- Answer: Payment revision errors occur when the billing ZIP code doesn't match bank records, your bank declined a 3D Secure/fraud check, or an Amazon gift card balance partially split the order incorrectly. Delete and re-add the card under Your Payments with the exact bank-registered billing address, call your bank to approve Amazon pre-authorizations, and select Change Payment Method inside the affected order.

### How do I merge two separate Amazon accounts (e.g., Prime on one email, Kindle books on another)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/two-separate-amazon-accounts-e-g-prime-on-one-email-kindle-books-on-anot
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Account Locked, On Hold, OTP/2FA, Hacked Account & Verification Loops
- Answer: Amazon cannot merge two separate accounts into one login, nor transfer order history between them. However, you can link two adult Amazon accounts cleanly via Amazon Household (Your Account > Amazon Household), which lets both logins share Prime shipping, Prime Video, and Kindle eBook libraries while keeping separate order histories and passwords.

### How do I remove an ex-partner or unknown device from my Amazon account and Prime Video?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/an-ex-partner-or-unknown-device-from-my-amazon-account-and-prime-video
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Account Locked, On Hold, OTP/2FA, Hacked Account & Verification Loops
- Answer: Change your Amazon password first, then go to Your Account > Content & Devices > Devices (plus Prime Video > Settings > Your Devices) and click Deregister next to every unrecognized TV, Fire Stick, phone, or Kindle. Finally, enable 2-Step Verification under Login & Security so deregistered devices cannot re-authenticate.

### How do I fix Amazon Passkey sign-in failing on iPhone, Android, or Windows Hello?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-passkey-sign-in-failing-on-iphone-android-or-windows-hello
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Account Locked, On Hold, OTP/2FA, Hacked Account & Verification Loops
- Answer: Passkey loops happen when a device was replaced or synced passkeys corrupted in iCloud Keychain/Google Password Manager. Click Sign in with password instead, log into Your Account > Login & Security > Passkey, delete the broken passkey entry, and create a fresh passkey on your current device.

### How do I stop fake Amazon "Your order for $1,299 iPhone/MacBook has been confirmed" scam calls and texts?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/fake-amazon-your-order-for-1-299-iphone-macbook-has-been-confirmed-scam
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Account Locked, On Hold, OTP/2FA, Hacked Account & Verification Loops
- Answer: These are classic refund/remote-access tech support scams trying to trick you into calling back or installing AnyDesk. Never call numbers in texts or emails. Open the official Amazon app directly and check Your Orders and Message Center (all genuine Amazon emails appear inside Your Account > Message Center). Forward scam emails to stop-spoofing@amazon.com.

### How do I fix Amazon Business account conversion accidentally changing my personal Prime account?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-business-account-conversion-accidentally-changing-my-personal-pri
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Account Locked, On Hold, OTP/2FA, Hacked Account & Verification Loops
- Answer: Converting a personal login into an Amazon Business account disables standard Amazon Household sharing and alters personal Prime benefits. To revert, go to Business Settings > Close Business Account (select the option to keep your underlying personal login active if offered) or contact Amazon Business Customer Support directly to split/downgrade back to a personal consumer account.

### How do I permanently delete my Amazon account without losing access to active warranties or returns?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/how-do-i-permanently-delete-my-amazon-account-without-losing-access-to-a
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Account Locked, On Hold, OTP/2FA, Hacked Account & Verification Loops
- Answer: Download any needed tax/warranty invoices from Your Orders first and wait for all pending deliveries/refunds to settle (closing an account permanently forfeits all Kindle books, Prime Video purchases, Audible credits, and gift card balances). Then visit amazon.com/privacy/data-deletion, confirm your choice, and click the verification link emailed within 5 days.

### My Amazon package says "Delivered" with a photo of the wrong porch (or no photo)—how do I get a replacement or refund?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/my-amazon-package-says-delivered-with-a-photo-of-the-wrong-porch-or-no-p
- Sub-Topic: Orders, Missing Packages, Returns, Refunds, A-to-Z Claims & Gift Cards
- Answer: Check around side doors, mailboxes, and immediate neighbors first (carriers occasionally mark delivered 1–2 hours early). Open Your Orders > [Item] > Problem with order > Package didn't arrive, verify the delivery photo doesn't match your home, and request a replacement or refund via Amazon Customer Service—for high-value stolen items, Amazon may require a brief Incident Report or local police report number.

### Why is Amazon requiring a 6-digit One-Time Passcode (OTP) at delivery and what if I won't be home?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-requiring-a-6-digit-one-time-passcode-otp-at-delivery-and-what-if
- Sub-Topic: Orders, Missing Packages, Returns, Refunds, A-to-Z Claims & Gift Cards
- Answer: Amazon automatically enforces an in-person 6-digit delivery OTP on high-value electronics or addresses with prior theft history; drivers cannot leave the package unattended without it. Find the code in Your Orders > Track Package (emailed on delivery day), share it only with a trusted household member receiving the parcel, or reschedule delivery to an Amazon Locker / Counter pickup point.

### How do I fix an Amazon return dropped off at UPS/Whole Foods/Kohl's that still shows "Return Started" with no refund after 14+ days?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/an-amazon-return-dropped-off-at-ups-whole-foods-kohl-s-that-still-shows
- Sub-Topic: Orders, Missing Packages, Returns, Refunds, A-to-Z Claims & Gift Cards
- Answer: Return refunds sometimes stall in transit between consolidation centers and Amazon warehouses, especially for items over $300 requiring manual inspection (up to 30 days). Locate your physical UPS/Whole Foods drop-off receipt showing the tracking number and weight, open Amazon Support chat (Orders > Help with Return), provide the drop-off tracking ID, and request a manual refund release.

### Amazon says I returned the "wrong item" or an "empty box" and re-charged my card—how do I dispute it?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-says-i-returned-the-wrong-item-or-an-empty-box-and-re-charged-my
- Sub-Topic: Orders, Missing Packages, Returns, Refunds, A-to-Z Claims & Gift Cards
- Answer: Warehouse scan swaps or carrier transit tampering occasionally trigger automated "Wrong Item Returned" re-charges. Reply immediately with your carrier drop-off receipt showing exact parcel weight (proving the box wasn't empty) and serial number photos if taken, escalate via jeff@amazon.com / Executive Customer Relations if frontline chat refuses to review the weight scan, and document every chat transcript.

### How do I file and win an Amazon A-to-z Guarantee Claim against an unresponsive third-party seller?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/how-do-i-file-and-win-an-amazon-a-to-z-guarantee-claim-against-an-unresp
- Sub-Topic: Orders, Missing Packages, Returns, Refunds, A-to-Z Claims & Gift Cards
- Answer: Wait 48 hours after messaging the third-party seller through Buyer-Seller Messaging (required before filing), then open Your Orders > Problem with order > Request refund (eligible within 90 days of the estimated delivery date) for non-delivery, damaged/defective goods, or an unrefunded return after tracking confirms seller receipt.

### Why did Amazon charge me a $1.00 or $6.99 UPS pickup/drop-off return fee on a Prime item?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-charge-me-a-1-00-or-6-99-ups-pickup-drop-off-return-fee-on-a-prim
- Sub-Topic: Orders, Missing Packages, Returns, Refunds, A-to-Z Claims & Gift Cards
- Answer: Amazon now charges a UPS Store drop-off fee when a free Whole Foods, Amazon Fresh, Kohl's, or Staples drop-off location is closer to your delivery address, OR when the return reason is buyer-remorse (e.g., "No longer needed") on non-free-returns items. Select Whole Foods / Kohl's / Amazon Locker on the return options screen to avoid the UPS fee, or accurately select Defective/Damaged/Inaccurate Website Description if the product is faulty.

### How do I redeem an Amazon Gift Card when the claim code was scratched off too hard or is unreadable?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/an-amazon-gift-card-when-the-claim-code-was-scratched-off-too-hard-or-is
- Sub-Topic: Orders, Missing Packages, Returns, Refunds, A-to-Z Claims & Gift Cards
- Answer: Do not discard the card or receipt. Contact Amazon Customer Service via chat/phone with: (1) the 16-digit serial number printed openly on the back of the card, (2) a clear photo of the front and back of the card, and (3) a photo of the original store purchase receipt showing card activation so Amazon can verify and credit your account balance.

### What should I do if my brand-new physical Amazon Gift Card says "Already redeemed to another account"?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/i-do-if-my-brand-new-physical-amazon-gift-card-says-already-redeemed-to
- Sub-Topic: Orders, Missing Packages, Returns, Refunds, A-to-Z Claims & Gift Cards
- Answer: This indicates retail shelf tampering where scammers copy card codes and reseal packaging before purchase. Keep the card, packaging, and store receipt; contact Amazon Gift Card Fraud Support immediately with the card's serial number and receipt so Amazon can trace when/if the card was redeemed (if redeemed before your receipt timestamp, Amazon or the retailer can void and replace it).

### Why did Amazon void my Gift Card balance and lock my account after redeeming a third-party gift card?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-void-my-gift-card-balance-and-lock-my-account-after-redeeming-a-t
- Sub-Topic: Orders, Missing Packages, Returns, Refunds, A-to-Z Claims & Gift Cards
- Answer: Amazon's fraud engine freezes accounts when gift cards purchased from unauthorized resellers (Craigslist, Telegram, discounted key sites) turn out to be bought with stolen credit cards. Submit the legitimate retail purchase receipt via the Account Expert portal—never buy discounted Amazon gift cards from unverified individuals.

### How do I cancel an Amazon order that already says "Preparing for Shipment" or "Shipping Now"?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/an-amazon-order-that-already-says-preparing-for-shipment-or-shipping-now
- Sub-Topic: Orders, Missing Packages, Returns, Refunds, A-to-Z Claims & Gift Cards
- Answer: Once an order enters Shipping Now, warehouse automation blocks direct cancellation. Click Request Cancellation under Your Orders anyway (sometimes succeeds before carrier pickup); if it ships, either click Refuse Delivery with the carrier or start a free return once it arrives.

### Why did Amazon send me an empty sealed envelope or a completely wrong item (e.g., cheap cable instead of SSD)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-send-me-an-empty-sealed-envelope-or-a-completely-wrong-item-e-g-c
- Sub-Topic: Orders, Missing Packages, Returns, Refunds, A-to-Z Claims & Gift Cards
- Answer: Inventory commingling or warehouse picking swaps cause wrong-item deliveries. Photograph the shipping label (showing weight on the label!), the outer packaging, and the wrong product immediately, then go to Your Orders > Return or Replace Items > Wrong item was sent and contact Amazon Customer Service directly for high-value electronics so an agent documents the mis-pick properly.

### Why is my Amazon refund still not showing in my bank account after Amazon marked it "Refunded"?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/my-amazon-refund-still-not-showing-in-my-bank-account-after-amazon-marke
- Sub-Topic: Orders, Missing Packages, Returns, Refunds, A-to-Z Claims & Gift Cards
- Answer: Amazon Gift Card balance refunds post within 2–3 hours, whereas credit/debit card refunds take 3–5 business days (up to 10 business days for some debit banks) after Amazon initiates settlement. Check Your Account > Your Payments > Transactions to verify the exact refund date and whether it went to Gift Card Balance instead of your bank card.

### How do I fix "This item cannot be shipped to your selected delivery location" on Amazon?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/this-item-cannot-be-shipped-to-your-selected-delivery-location-on-amazon
- Sub-Topic: Orders, Missing Packages, Returns, Refunds, A-to-Z Claims & Gift Cards
- Answer: This occurs from P.O. Box restrictions (heavy/lithium-battery items require street addresses), state regulatory restrictions (e.g., California CEC energy/water rules, certain air rifles/batteries), or third-party seller geographic limits. Switch from a P.O. Box to a physical street address or Amazon Locker, or pick an alternate seller under Other Sellers on Amazon.

### How do I return an item labeled "Non-returnable" (e.g., groceries, electronics with hazardous lithium batteries, or software) that arrived damaged or expired?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/how-do-i-return-an-item-labeled-non-returnable-e-g-groceries-electronics
- Sub-Topic: Orders, Missing Packages, Returns, Refunds, A-to-Z Claims & Gift Cards
- Answer: Although self-service returns are disabled on non-returnable categories, Amazon's Damaged/Defective/Expired Guarantee still covers you. Go to Help > Contact Us > Chat with Customer Service, select the affected order, state that the item arrived damaged/expired/defective, and request a refundless-return credit or replacement.

### Why did Amazon split my single order into 4 separate bank card charges?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-split-my-single-order-into-4-separate-bank-card-charges
- Sub-Topic: Orders, Missing Packages, Returns, Refunds, A-to-Z Claims & Gift Cards
- Answer: Amazon does not charge your card when you place an order—it charges your card per individual shipment as each warehouse dispatches its items. Add the individual shipment charges together and compare against Your Orders > Invoice > Transactions to confirm the total matches your original order grand total.

### How do I fix an Amazon Promo Code or Coupon clipping not applying at checkout?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/an-amazon-promo-code-or-coupon-clipping-not-applying-at-checkout
- Sub-Topic: Orders, Missing Packages, Returns, Refunds, A-to-Z Claims & Gift Cards
- Answer: Amazon coupons only apply to items shipped and sold by the exact qualifying seller listed on the coupon (not Subscribe & Save unless eligible, and single-use per account). Verify the product isn't bought from a different third-party seller under "Other Sellers," confirm minimum order subtotal before tax, and check the final Review your order screen (coupons often appear only at the final step, not in Cart).

### Why am I seeing an unexpected $14.99 or $139 Amazon Prime charge—and how do I cancel and get a full refund?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/i-seeing-an-unexpected-14-99-or-139-amazon-prime-charge-and-how-do-i-can
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Prime Billing, Unexpected Charges, Subscribe & Save & Prime Video Errors
- Answer: Unexpected Prime charges usually result from an expired 30-day free trial, accidental one-click trial enrollment during checkout, or a forgotten second Amazon account. Go to Your Account > Prime Membership > Update, cancel and more > End Membership; if you have not used Prime shipping or Prime Video benefits since the billing date, Amazon automatically issues a full refund (or prorated refund via Customer Service chat).

### Why is Amazon charging me $2.99, $6.99, $9.99, or $11.99 every month separately from Prime?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-charging-me-2-99-6-99-9-99-or-11-99-every-month-separately-from-p
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Prime Billing, Unexpected Charges, Subscribe & Save & Prime Video Errors
- Answer: Extra monthly Amazon charges are almost always Prime Video Add-On Channels (Paramount+, Max, Starz, AMC+, MGM+), Prime Video Ad-Free ($2.99/mo), Amazon Music Unlimited, Kindle Unlimited ($11.99/mo), or Audible ($14.95/mo). Open Your Account > Memberships & Subscriptions to audit and cancel every active add-on individually—canceling Prime does NOT always cancel Audible or Kindle Unlimited.

### How do I cancel Amazon Subscribe & Save deliveries before they charge my card again?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-subscribe-save-deliveries-before-they-charge-my-card-again
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Prime Billing, Unexpected Charges, Subscribe & Save & Prime Video Errors
- Answer: Open Your Account > Subscribe & Save > Subscriptions, click each active product, and select Cancel subscription (note: clicking "Skip" only skips one month). Cancel at least 24–48 hours before the listed "Last day to edit" date so the warehouse doesn't already lock the shipment for dispatch.

### How do I fix Amazon Prime Video Error 5004 (Sign-in / Authentication Failed)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-prime-video-error-5004-sign-in-authentication-failed
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Prime Billing, Unexpected Charges, Subscribe & Save & Prime Video Errors
- Answer: Error 5004 means Prime Video failed account authentication due to stale app tokens, VPN blocking, or wrong credentials. Disable any VPN/proxy, sign out completely, clear the Prime Video app cache/data (or delete primevideo.com browser cookies), verify your password by logging into amazon.com, and sign back into Prime Video.

### How do I fix Amazon Prime Video Error 7031, 7035, or 7235 (Playback & Streaming Error)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-prime-video-error-7031-7035-or-7235-playback-streaming-error
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Prime Billing, Unexpected Charges, Subscribe & Save & Prime Video Errors
- Answer: Errors 7031 and 7235 indicate corrupted streaming cache, outdated Widevine DRM browser components, or unstable network routing. Update Chrome/Edge (visit chrome://components and update Widevine Content Decryption Module), disable browser hardware acceleration or ad blockers, restart your smart TV/Fire Stick by unplugging for 60 seconds, and update the Prime Video app.

### How do I fix Amazon Prime Video Error 2016, 2021, or 2026 (Billing / Payment Verification Error)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-prime-video-error-2016-2021-or-2026-billing-payment-verification
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Prime Billing, Unexpected Charges, Subscribe & Save & Prime Video Errors
- Answer: Errors 2016/2021/2026 happen because Amazon stores 1-Click Digital Payment Settings separately from your normal retail checkout card. Go to Your Account > Your Payments > Settings (1-Click / Digital Purchases), update your expired debit/credit card specifically for Digital Orders & Prime Video Channels, and verify your billing country matches your location.

### How do I fix Amazon Prime Video Error 1060 (Low Bandwidth / Network Connection Issue)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-prime-video-error-1060-low-bandwidth-network-connection-issue
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Prime Billing, Unexpected Charges, Subscribe & Save & Prime Video Errors
- Answer: Error 1060 indicates packet loss or slow throughput to Amazon's CDN. Reboot your modem/router, switch your Fire TV/Smart TV from 2.4 GHz to 5 GHz Wi-Fi (or Ethernet), pause heavy downloads/backups on the network, disable VPNs, and lower Prime Video streaming quality from Best to Better temporarily if your ISP is congested.

### How do I fix Amazon Prime Video Error 9074 or 4601 ("This video is currently unavailable to watch in your location")?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-prime-video-error-9074-or-4601-this-video-is-currently-unavailabl
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Prime Billing, Unexpected Charges, Subscribe & Save & Prime Video Errors
- Answer: Error 4601/9074 triggers when a VPN, proxy, or Apple iCloud Private Relay masks your IP address, or your Amazon account's Country/Region Setting under Content & Devices > Preferences doesn't match your physical country. Turn off all VPNs/proxies, restart your router to obtain a clean residential IP, and verify your Amazon Country/Region setting.

### How do I fix Amazon Prime Video audio out of sync with video or stuck playing Audio Description / wrong language?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-prime-video-audio-out-of-sync-with-video-or-stuck-playing-audio-d
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Prime Billing, Unexpected Charges, Subscribe & Save & Prime Video Errors
- Answer: While playing the title, press Up/Down on your remote, open Audio & Languages, and switch from English [Audio Description] back to standard English (or Stereo if Dolby Digital Plus lags on your soundbar). On Fire TV/Apple TV, go to Display & Sounds > Audio > AV Sync Tuning to correct lip-sync delay.

### How do I fix Amazon Prime Video asking me to rent or buy a movie that says "Included with Prime"?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-prime-video-asking-me-to-rent-or-buy-a-movie-that-says-included-w
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Prime Billing, Unexpected Charges, Subscribe & Save & Prime Video Errors
- Answer: This occurs when you are signed into a non-Prime Amazon account, a title moved to an add-on channel (e.g., MGM+/Paramount+), or your Prime membership payment lapsed. Verify Prime Status: Active under Your Account > Prime Membership, deregister and re-register the TV app using the exact Prime email, and check the blue checkmark vs. yellow bag icon next to the title.

### How do I set a Prime Video PIN so kids can't accidentally buy $19.99 movies with one click?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/a-prime-video-pin-so-kids-can-t-accidentally-buy-19-99-movies-with-one-c
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Prime Billing, Unexpected Charges, Subscribe & Save & Prime Video Errors
- Answer: Open primevideo.com/settings/parental-controls on a browser, create a 5-digit Prime Video PIN, enable Purchase Restrictions (PIN on Purchase), and check Apply PIN to all devices on this account (Fire TV, Smart TVs, iPads, and phones) to block accidental 1-Click rentals and channel trials.

### How do I fix Amazon Prime Student / Prime Young Adult verification failing with my .edu email?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-prime-student-prime-young-adult-verification-failing-with-my-edu
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Prime Billing, Unexpected Charges, Subscribe & Save & Prime Video Errors
- Answer: If your .edu email isn't automatically recognized, upload an official current semester class schedule, tuition bill, or dated student ID (or age-verification ID for the 18–24 Young Adult tier) directly via the Prime Student verification portal and wait 2–4 business days for manual approval.

### Why am I paying for Amazon Prime but my orders still charge shipping or take 5–7 days instead of 2-day delivery?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/i-paying-for-amazon-prime-but-my-orders-still-charge-shipping-or-take-5
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Prime Billing, Unexpected Charges, Subscribe & Save & Prime Video Errors
- Answer: Only items marked with the Prime badge (Fulfilled by Amazon) qualify for free 2-day shipping—third-party merchant-fulfilled items set their own shipping fees and timelines. Also verify you didn't accidentally select No-Rush Shipping at checkout and that your default address isn't a remote/rural ZIP with longer carrier transit.

### How do I fix Amazon Music Unlimited asking me to upgrade even though I have Amazon Prime?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-music-unlimited-asking-me-to-upgrade-even-though-i-have-amazon-pr
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Prime Billing, Unexpected Charges, Subscribe & Save & Prime Video Errors
- Answer: Amazon Music Prime (included with Prime) plays most tracks in shuffle-only mode with limited skips, whereas Amazon Music Unlimited ($9.99–$10.99/mo) is a separate paid tier for on-demand playback and Ultra HD. If you *do* pay for Unlimited, sign out of the Amazon Music app and verify you are logged into the exact account billed under Memberships & Subscriptions.

### How do I cancel Audible without losing my unused Audible credits or purchased audiobooks?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/audible-without-losing-my-unused-audible-credits-or-purchased-audiobooks
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Prime Billing, Unexpected Charges, Subscribe & Save & Prime Video Errors
- Answer: Canceling Audible forfeits all unused monthly credits immediately, whereas purchased audiobooks stay in your library forever. Spend every remaining credit on audiobooks first, then go to audible.com/account/overview on a desktop browser (in-app cancellation isn't always shown on iOS/Android) and click Cancel membership (or Pause membership for up to 90 days to preserve credits).

### How do I fix Amazon Household Prime sharing not giving the second adult free Prime shipping?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-household-prime-sharing-not-giving-the-second-adult-free-prime-sh
- Sub-Topic: Amazon Prime Billing, Unexpected Charges, Subscribe & Save & Prime Video Errors
- Answer: Both adults must explicitly enable Share Payment Methods (required by Amazon to verify same-household residency) under Your Account > Amazon Household > Manage Household, reside in the same country, and confirm neither adult left another Amazon Household within the past 180 days.

### How do I fix Amazon Fire TV Stick remote blinking orange continuously and not controlling the TV?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-fire-tv-stick-remote-blinking-orange-continuously-and-not-control
- Sub-Topic: Fire TV Stick, Fire Tablet & Kindle E-Reader Troubleshooting
- Answer: Blinking orange means the remote dropped Bluetooth pairing or has weak batteries. Insert brand-new alkaline AAA batteries, unplug the Fire Stick for 60 seconds, plug back in, and hold Home for 15 seconds. If it fails, factory reset the remote: unplug Fire Stick, hold Left + Menu (3 lines) + Back together for 12 seconds, remove batteries, plug Fire Stick in, reinsert batteries, and hold Home for 10 seconds.

### How do I fix Amazon Fire TV Stick "Home Is Currently Unavailable" error preventing apps from loading?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-fire-tv-stick-home-is-currently-unavailable-error-preventing-apps
- Sub-Topic: Fire TV Stick, Fire Tablet & Kindle E-Reader Troubleshooting
- Answer: "Home Is Currently Unavailable" occurs when Fire OS loses Amazon account registration, DNS fails, or an active VPN/Pi-hole blocks Amazon's Fire TV launcher endpoints. Test Settings > Network (click Play/Pause to check connection status), turn off VPNs or ad-blocking DNS temporarily, sync Settings > My Account > Sync Amazon Content, clear cache for Amazon Appstore and Prime Video, or deregister and re-register your Amazon account.

### How do I fix Amazon Fire TV Stick "Critically Low Storage" warning preventing app launches and updates?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-fire-tv-stick-critically-low-storage-warning-preventing-app-launc
- Sub-Topic: Fire TV Stick, Fire Tablet & Kindle E-Reader Troubleshooting
- Answer: Standard 8 GB Fire Sticks fill rapidly with hidden app caches and screensaver/bloat files. Go to Settings > Applications > Manage Installed Applications, sort by size, click Clear Cache (not Clear Data) on Prime Video, Netflix, YouTube, and Silk Browser, uninstall unused apps, and turn off Featured Content Autoplay under Settings > Preferences.

### How do I fix Amazon Fire TV Stick showing a black screen or "No Signal" on my TV?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-fire-tv-stick-showing-a-black-screen-or-no-signal-on-my-tv
- Sub-Topic: Fire TV Stick, Fire Tablet & Kindle E-Reader Troubleshooting
- Answer: Confirm the TV is on the exact HDMI input, use the short HDMI extender dongle included in the box (improves Wi-Fi and prevents tight-port strain), power-cycle both TV and Fire Stick, and cycle display resolutions blindly by holding Up + Rewind on the Fire Stick remote for 5 seconds until a readable resolution appears and click Use Current Resolution.

### How do I fix Amazon Fire TV Stick "Connected with Problems" or unable to connect to home Wi-Fi?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-fire-tv-stick-connected-with-problems-or-unable-to-connect-to-hom
- Sub-Topic: Fire TV Stick, Fire Tablet & Kindle E-Reader Troubleshooting
- Answer: Fire Sticks reject certain high 5 GHz DFS router channels (channels 52–144). Set your router's 5 GHz channel manually to 36, 40, 44, or 48 (or connect to 2.4 GHz), attach the included HDMI extender to move the Stick away from metal TV shielding, forget and re-enter Wi-Fi password, and verify router DNS isn't blocking Amazon servers.

### How do I fix Amazon Fire TV Stick remote volume and power buttons not controlling my TV or soundbar?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-fire-tv-stick-remote-volume-and-power-buttons-not-controlling-my
- Sub-Topic: Fire TV Stick, Fire Tablet & Kindle E-Reader Troubleshooting
- Answer: Go to Settings > Equipment Control > Manage Equipment > TV > Change TV, follow the guided IR code test while pointing the remote directly at the TV's IR sensor (ensure nothing blocks the TV's bottom infrared receiver), and enable HDMI-CEC Device Control under Settings > Display & Sounds.

### How do I fix Amazon Fire Tablet (Fire HD 8 / HD 10 / Kids) stuck on the Fire logo or black screen?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-fire-tablet-fire-hd-8-hd-10-kids-stuck-on-the-fire-logo-or-black
- Sub-Topic: Fire TV Stick, Fire Tablet & Kindle E-Reader Troubleshooting
- Answer: Plug the Fire Tablet into a wall charger for 30 minutes (deeply drained batteries won't display anything immediately), then press and hold the Power button for a full 40 seconds to force a hardware reboot. If stuck on the Fire logo, boot Recovery Mode (Power + Volume Down/Up depending on model) and select Wipe cache partition first before considering Factory Reset.

### How do I fix Amazon Fire Kids Tablet stuck in Kids Profile or unable to exit Amazon Kids+?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-fire-kids-tablet-stuck-in-kids-profile-or-unable-to-exit-amazon-k
- Sub-Topic: Fire TV Stick, Fire Tablet & Kindle E-Reader Troubleshooting
- Answer: Swipe down twice from the top of the screen, tap the Adult Profile icon (or Settings gear), and enter your Parent PIN / Lock Screen Password. If you forgot the Parent PIN, enter the wrong PIN 5 times until the Reset PIN prompt appears and verify with your Amazon account password—or manage profiles remotely via parents.amazon.com.

### How do I fix Kindle Paperwhite / Scribe / Oasis frozen screen or unresponsive touch?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/kindle-paperwhite-scribe-oasis-frozen-screen-or-unresponsive-touch
- Sub-Topic: Fire TV Stick, Fire Tablet & Kindle E-Reader Troubleshooting
- Answer: E-Ink displays hold the last rendered image even when the OS freezes or the battery dies completely. Plug the Kindle into a wall charger for 1 hour (confirm the bottom LED turns amber/green), then press and hold the Power button for a full 40 seconds until the screen flashes and shows the tree-reading boot screen.

### How do I fix Kindle Error E999 or "Send to Kindle" email/EPUB delivery failing?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/kindle-error-e999-or-send-to-kindle-email-epub-delivery-failing
- Sub-Topic: Fire TV Stick, Fire Tablet & Kindle E-Reader Troubleshooting
- Answer: Kindle E999 signals a server-sync or DRM/file-format error during Send-to-Kindle or store download. Confirm your sender email is whitelisted under Your Account > Content & Devices > Preferences > Personal Document Settings > Approved Personal Document E-mail List, ensure the file is standard EPUB/PDF (Amazon deprecated legacy .mobi via Send-to-Kindle), and restart your Kindle on Wi-Fi.

### How do I fix purchased Kindle books not showing up in my Kindle library or stuck on "Queued"?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/purchased-kindle-books-not-showing-up-in-my-kindle-library-or-stuck-on-q
- Sub-Topic: Fire TV Stick, Fire Tablet & Kindle E-Reader Troubleshooting
- Answer: Most missing Kindle books are caused by being logged into a different Amazon email or having the Library filter set to Downloaded instead of All. Switch the Library tab to All, tap Sync from the top quick-settings bar, confirm your device is listed under amazon.com/mycd (Content & Devices), click Deliver or Remove from Device, and verify your 1-Click payment didn't fail.

### How do I fix Kindle battery draining overnight after loading new books?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/kindle-battery-draining-overnight-after-loading-new-books
- Sub-Topic: Fire TV Stick, Fire Tablet & Kindle E-Reader Troubleshooting
- Answer: Newly downloaded books trigger heavy background text indexing—and a single corrupted ebook can trap the indexer in an infinite loop draining 100% overnight. Type a nonsense string like zxqwerty into the Kindle search bar; if "Text in Books (X items not yet indexed)" appears, tap it to see which book is stuck, delete and re-download that book, and enable Airplane Mode when reading offline.

### How do I fix Kindle Paperwhite / Scribe unable to connect to Wi-Fi ("Unable to connect to your Wi-Fi network")?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/kindle-paperwhite-scribe-unable-to-connect-to-wi-fi-unable-to-connect-to
- Sub-Topic: Fire TV Stick, Fire Tablet & Kindle E-Reader Troubleshooting
- Answer: Older Kindles only support 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi (channels 1–11) and WPA2-PSK (failing on 5 GHz-only or WPA3-only networks). Enable a 2.4 GHz WPA2/WPA3-mixed SSID on your router, forget the network on the Kindle, restart the Kindle (40-second hold), and verify Date & Time aren't wildly out of sync.

### How do I fix Kindle Unlimited "Limit Reached (20 titles)" blocking me from borrowing another book?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/kindle-unlimited-limit-reached-20-titles-blocking-me-from-borrowing-anot
- Sub-Topic: Fire TV Stick, Fire Tablet & Kindle E-Reader Troubleshooting
- Answer: Kindle Unlimited enforces a hard cap of 20 simultaneously borrowed titles across all devices on your account. Visit amazon.com/ku (or Kindle > Your Library > Filter: Kindle Unlimited), tap the three dots next to a finished book, and select Return Kindle Unlimited Book to free a slot immediately.

### What do the colored light rings on Amazon Echo / Alexa mean (Yellow, Red, Purple, Green, Blue)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/the-colored-light-rings-on-amazon-echo-alexa-mean-yellow-red-purple-gree
- Sub-Topic: Alexa, Echo Smart Speakers, Ring Doorbells, Blink Cameras & Seller Central
- Answer: Pulsing Yellow = unread Amazon delivery notification or message (say *"Alexa, read my notifications"*); Solid Red = microphone muted (press the mic-off button on top); Flashing Purple = Wi-Fi setup error or Do Not Disturb enabled; Spinning Green = incoming call or active Drop In; Spinning Orange = Wi-Fi pairing/setup mode.

### How do I fix Amazon Echo / Echo Dot saying "Having trouble understanding right now" or dropping Wi-Fi constantly?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-echo-echo-dot-saying-having-trouble-understanding-right-now-or-dr
- Sub-Topic: Alexa, Echo Smart Speakers, Ring Doorbells, Blink Cameras & Seller Central
- Answer: Unplug the Echo and your Wi-Fi router for 60 seconds, verify the Echo isn't placed right beside microwave ovens or thick brick walls, check Alexa App > Devices > [Echo] > Wi-Fi Network > Change to reconnect, disable router Smart Connect / Band Steering if it bounces between 2.4/5 GHz, and ensure your router isn't blocking Amazon NTP/DNS servers.

### How do I fix Alexa smart home devices (plugs, bulbs, thermostats) showing "Device is unresponsive"?

- Answer: "Device is unresponsive" means the third-party cloud skill token (Kasa, Hue, Govee, Smart Life, Ecobee) expired. First test if the bulb/plug works in the manufacturer's own app; if yes, open the Alexa App > More > Skills & Games > Your Skills, find the brand's skill, tap Disable Skill, then Enable to Use and sign back in to refresh OAuth linking.

### How do I fix Amazon Echo Show screen flickering, freezing, or showing unwanted "By the way" ads/suggestions?

To reduce home screen clutter and ads, open Settings > Home Content on the Echo Show and toggle off unwanted cards (Discovery, Shopping Recommendations, Trending Topics).

### How do I factory reset an Amazon Echo Dot / Echo Show to give away or fix setup failure?

### How do I fix Ring Video Doorbell stuck offline or failing to reconnect to Wi-Fi after changing routers?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/ring-video-doorbell-stuck-offline-or-failing-to-reconnect-to-wi-fi-after
- Sub-Topic: Alexa, Echo Smart Speakers, Ring Doorbells, Blink Cameras & Seller Central
- Answer: Most Ring doorbells require 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi (WPA2) and fail on pure 5 GHz or hidden SSIDs. Check signal strength (RSSI under Ring App > Device Health—worse than -65 needs a Ring Chime Pro or mesh node), press the orange/black setup button to enter setup mode, open Ring App > Device Health > Reconnect to Wi-Fi, and disable VPNs on your phone during setup.

### How do I fix Ring Video Doorbell Live View failing ("Streaming Error" or black loading circle)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/ring-video-doorbell-live-view-failing-streaming-error-or-black-loading-c
- Sub-Topic: Alexa, Echo Smart Speakers, Ring Doorbells, Blink Cameras & Seller Central
- Answer: Live View failures are caused by weak upload bandwidth (< 2 Mbps at the doorway), poor Wi-Fi RSSI, or strict VPN/firewall rules blocking WebRTC ports. Check Device Health > Signal Strength (RSSI), test Live View on cellular data vs. Wi-Fi (using the Rapid Ring / updated Ring App), reboot your router, and verify your doorbell battery is above 20%.

### How do I fix Ring Doorbell battery draining completely in just a few days?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/ring-doorbell-battery-draining-completely-in-just-a-few-days
- Sub-Topic: Alexa, Echo Smart Speakers, Ring Doorbells, Blink Cameras & Seller Central
- Answer: Excessive motion triggers (passing cars/swaying trees), frequent Live View checks, freezing temperatures (< 32°F / 0°C), and weak Wi-Fi forcing high-power retries drain Ring batteries rapidly. Open Ring App > Motion Settings, draw tighter Motion Zones excluding streets/sidewalks, enable Smart Alerts (Person Only), set Motion Frequency to Regularly, and improve Wi-Fi RSSI.

### Why did my Ring Doorbell stop saving recorded videos and ask for a Ring Home / Ring Protect subscription?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/my-ring-doorbell-stop-saving-recorded-videos-and-ask-for-a-ring-home-rin

Log into ring.com (not the iOS app) to check Account > Plan and verify the subscription is assigned to the correct device/location.

### How do I fix Ring Doorbell not ringing my existing wired indoor mechanical chime?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/ring-doorbell-not-ringing-my-existing-wired-indoor-mechanical-chime
- Sub-Topic: Alexa, Echo Smart Speakers, Ring Doorbells, Blink Cameras & Seller Central
- Answer: Under-powered doorbell transformers (< 16V AC / 30VA) or incorrect In-Home Chime settings prevent mechanical bells from striking. Open Ring App > Device Settings > In-home Chime Settings, confirm Ring my in-home chime is ON and set accurately to Mechanical vs. Digital, verify the Pro Power Kit is wired across the chime terminals (for Ring Pro models), and upgrade old 10V transformers to 16V–24V AC.

### How do I fix Ring Doorbell "Device is still registered to another owner" when moving into a new home?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/ring-doorbell-device-is-still-registered-to-another-owner-when-moving-in

- Answer: Ring enforces anti-theft ownership locking. Tap Request Device Ownership Transfer right inside the Ring App during setup—Ring emails the previous owner; if they approve (or don't decline within 15 days), Ring automatically releases the device so you can register it to your account.

### How do I fix Blink Sync Module 2 offline (solid red light or blinking blue) and cameras not recording?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/blink-sync-module-2-offline-solid-red-light-or-blinking-blue-and-cameras

### How do I fix Blink Camera local USB storage (Sync Module 2) not saving clips after canceling Blink Subscription?

Note that local clips appear under Clips > Local Storage (tap the dropdown at top of Clips tab—NOT the Cloud tab!), and safely eject before unplugging.

### How do I fix Blink Outdoor / Indoor camera batteries dying within weeks instead of 2 years?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/blink-outdoor-indoor-camera-batteries-dying-within-weeks-instead-of-2-ye
- Sub-Topic: Alexa, Echo Smart Speakers, Ring Doorbells, Blink Cameras & Seller Central
- Answer: Blink cameras explicitly require Energizer Ultimate Lithium 1.5V AA batteries—standard alkaline or 1.2V rechargeable NiMH batteries drop voltage too quickly and read "Low Battery" within weeks. Switch to Energizer Ultimate Lithium AA cells, shorten Clip Length to 10–15 seconds, increase Retrigger Time to 30 seconds, and mask busy streets in Activity Zones.

### How do I fix Amazon Photos showing "Unlimited Photo Storage Full" or charging for storage?

### How do I fix Amazon Seller Central account deactivated under "Section 3" (Inform Consumers Act / Identity / Authenticity)?

### How do I fix Amazon Seller Central "Your credit card is invalid" blocking disbursement or login?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/amazon-seller-central-your-credit-card-is-invalid-blocking-disbursement
- Sub-Topic: Alexa, Echo Smart Speakers, Ring Doorbells, Blink Cameras & Seller Central

Update your Charge Method under Settings > Account Info > Charge Methods, verify your bank allows $1–$39.99 Amazon Seller authorizations, and allow up to 48 hours for validation.

### How do I fix Amazon Seller Central funds held in "Account Level Reserve" indefinitely?

## Antivirus & Security Suites (75 Guides)
Category Hub: https://answerdesk.online/guides/category/antivirus

### How do I fix Norton 360 Error 8504, 104 or 8504, 101 ("An unexpected error occurred")?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/norton-360-error-8504-104-or-8504-101-an-unexpected-error-occurred
- Sub-Topic: Norton 360 & LifeLock
- Answer: Norton error 8504, 104 is caused by corrupted program files, conflicting outdated GPU drivers, or leftover third-party antivirus drivers. Update your graphics drivers, uninstall any competing antivirus completely, then download and run the official Norton Remove and Reinstall tool (NRnR) from norton.com/nrnr to wipe damaged registries and reinstall a clean build.

### How do I fix Norton 360 Error 3048, 3 or 8921, 252 when running LiveUpdate?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/norton-360-error-3048-3-or-8921-252-when-running-liveupdate
- Sub-Topic: Norton 360 & LifeLock
- Answer: Error 3048, 3 means Norton's definition updater encountered corrupted patch files or a blocked HTTPS update route. Reboot your PC, verify Windows Date & Time are set automatically, disconnect VPNs temporarily, run LiveUpdate again manually, and if 3048, 3 returns, run the Norton Remove and Reinstall (NRnR) tool to reset the LiveUpdate engine.

### How do I stop Norton 360 from auto-renewing and get a refund for an unexpected annual charge?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/norton-360-from-auto-renewing-and-get-a-refund-for-an-unexpected-annual
- Sub-Topic: Norton 360 & LifeLock
- Answer: Sign into my.norton.com, click My Subscriptions, locate your active Norton 360 / LifeLock plan, and click Cancel Subscription Renewal (confirming through all retention screens until status shows Auto-Renew: Off). For an unexpected annual charge, Norton offers a 60-day money-back guarantee on annual plans (14 days on monthly)—contact Norton Billing Chat via support.norton.com with your Order Number for a full refund.

### How do I fix Norton Secure VPN stuck on "Connecting..." or disconnecting Wi-Fi completely?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/norton-secure-vpn-stuck-on-connecting-or-disconnecting-wi-fi-completely
- Sub-Topic: Norton 360 & LifeLock
- Answer: Norton VPN stalls when Windows TAP/Wintun virtual network adapters break or public Wi-Fi blocks UDP ports 500/4500. Switch VPN region from Auto-Select to a nearby country, toggle Kill Switch off temporarily to restore internet, open Device Manager > Network adapters to verify the Norton VPN adapter isn't disabled, and run NRnR if the virtual NIC driver is corrupted.

### How do I stop Norton Smart Firewall from blocking my home Wi-Fi printer, NAS, or local network shares?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/norton-smart-firewall-from-blocking-my-home-wi-fi-printer-nas-or-local-n
- Sub-Topic: Norton 360 & LifeLock
- Answer: Norton classifies new Wi-Fi networks as Public (Restricted) by default, which blocks LAN printer discovery and SMB shares. Open Norton 360 > Device Security > Settings > Firewall > Network Trust, find your home Wi-Fi SSID, and change its trust level from Public to Private (or Full Trust), then restart the printer.

### How do I completely uninstall Norton 360 when Windows Apps & Features fails or leaves services behind?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/uninstall-norton-360-when-windows-apps-features-fails-or-leaves-services
- Sub-Topic: Norton 360 & LifeLock
- Answer: Standard Windows uninstall often leaves Norton kernel filter drivers that block Windows Defender from turning back on. Download the official Norton Remove and Reinstall tool (NRnR), click Advanced Options > Remove Only > Remove, reboot when prompted, and confirm Windows Security (Defender) automatically activates afterward.

### How do I stop Norton 360 from showing constant "Upgrade / Special Offer / Driver Updater" pop-up ads?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/norton-360-from-showing-constant-upgrade-special-offer-driver-updater-po
- Sub-Topic: Norton 360 & LifeLock
- Answer: Open Norton 360 > Settings > Administrative Settings, toggle OFF Special Offer Notifications and Norton Product Suggestions (and disable Remote Management if unused). Also open Settings > Notifications to mute promotional marketing alerts while keeping critical malware alerts active.

### How do I restore a legitimate file or game .exe falsely quarantined by Norton Auto-Protect / SONAR?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/how-do-i-restore-a-legitimate-file-or-game-exe-falsely-quarantined-by-no
- Sub-Topic: Norton 360 & LifeLock
- Answer: Open Norton 360 > Security > History, filter by Quarantine, select the falsely flagged file, and click Restore & Exclude this file (verify the file's source first before excluding). For folders containing developer builds or games, add the directory under Settings > Antivirus > Scans and Risks > Exclusions / Low Risks > Items to Exclude from Auto-Protect, SONAR and Download Intelligence.

### How do I fix Norton 360 causing 100% Disk Usage or severe PC slowdown (NortonSecurity.exe high CPU)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/norton-360-causing-100-disk-usage-or-severe-pc-slowdown-nortonsecurity-e
- Sub-Topic: Norton 360 & LifeLock
- Answer: Background Idle Full System Scans, Norton Crypto/Cloud Backup, and conflicting secondary antivirus scanners spike CPU/disk usage. Confirm no second real-time antivirus (McAfee/Avast) is running alongside Norton, disable Automatic Cloud Backup if unused, disable Idle Time Optimizer, and schedule Full Scans once weekly overnight.

### How do I fix Norton Password Manager Vault locked or refusing to accept my Vault Password?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/norton-password-manager-vault-locked-or-refusing-to-accept-my-vault-pass
- Sub-Topic: Norton 360 & LifeLock
- Answer: Norton Password Manager uses zero-knowledge encryption—Norton cannot reset your Vault Password without losing stored entries unless you set up Biometric Mobile Unlock on a linked phone. Open the Norton Password Manager app on your trusted iPhone/Android to unlock with Face ID/Fingerprint and export or update the vault; if no mobile unlock exists, use your Recovery Key or delete and recreate an empty vault.

### How do I fix Norton 360 activation error "You have exceeded the maximum number of device installs" after reinstalling Windows?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/norton-360-activation-error-you-have-exceeded-the-maximum-number-of-devi
- Sub-Topic: Norton 360 & LifeLock
- Answer: Reinstalling Windows or replacing a PC leaves the old machine occupying a license seat. Log into my.norton.com > My Subscriptions > Manage Licenses, locate the inactive/old PC name, click the Trash icon (Remove License) to free the seat, then sign into Norton 360 on your current device.

### How do I fix Norton Safe Web browser extension slowing down Chrome/Edge or blocking legitimate websites?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/norton-safe-web-browser-extension-slowing-down-chrome-edge-or-blocking-l
