- Answer: Personal PCs show this error when leftover third-party antivirus policies, Windows debloater tweaks, or malware write UI-hiding keys under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender Security Center. Run elevated Command Prompt to delete HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Security Health UI and HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender policy overrides, reset Microsoft.SecHealthUI via PowerShell, and reboot.

### How do I fix "This setting is managed by your administrator" graying out Real-Time Protection on a home Windows 11 PC?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/this-setting-is-managed-by-your-administrator-graying-out-real-time-prot
- Sub-Topic: Admin Locks, Tamper Protection, Group Policy & Registry Restoration
- Answer: Check Settings > Accounts > Access work or school first—signing into a college/company Microsoft 365 account often silently enrolls your personal PC into corporate Intune MDM policies! Disconnect the work/school account (choose "This app only" when signing into Office next time), clear HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Real-Time Protection, and run gpupdate /force.

### How do I turn off or fix Tamper Protection when it is grayed out or won't toggle in Windows Security?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/how-do-i-turn-off-or-fix-tamper-protection-when-it-is-grayed-out-or-won
- Sub-Topic: Admin Locks, Tamper Protection, Group Policy & Registry Restoration
- Answer: Tamper Protection prevents scripts and malware from disabling Defender via Registry or PowerShell, so it can ONLY be toggled interactively inside the Windows Security GUI by an Administrator (unless locked by Intune/Microsoft Defender for Endpoint). Ensure you are signed into an Administrator Windows account and not enrolled in corporate Intune MDM under Access work or school.

### How do I fix Windows Defender Real-Time Protection automatically turning itself back ON after I turned it off temporarily?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-defender-real-time-protection-automatically-turning-itself-back
- Sub-Topic: Admin Locks, Tamper Protection, Group Policy & Registry Restoration
- Answer: By security design, toggling Real-Time Protection off in Windows Security is strictly temporary—Windows automatically re-enables it after a short interval or upon reboot to protect users from forgetting. Instead of disabling Defender globally, add a targeted File or Folder Exclusion under Virus & threat protection settings > Manage settings > Exclusions for verified safe software.

### How do I fix Windows Defender permanently stuck in "Periodic Scanning" mode after uninstalling McAfee or Norton?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-defender-permanently-stuck-in-periodic-scanning-mode-after-unins
- Sub-Topic: Admin Locks, Tamper Protection, Group Policy & Registry Restoration
- Answer: Periodic Scanning activates when Windows still detects another antivirus registered in WMI Security Center. Run the official cleanup tool for your old antivirus (MCPR, NRnR, Avast Clear, or Bitdefender Uninstall Tool), restart Windows, and confirm Virus & threat protection switches back from Periodic Scanning to full active Microsoft Defender Antivirus.

### How do I remove malicious exclusions secretly added to Windows Defender by malware (C:\ excluded)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/malicious-exclusions-secretly-added-to-windows-defender-by-malware-c-exc
- Sub-Topic: Admin Locks, Tamper Protection, Group Policy & Registry Restoration
- Answer: Sophisticated trojans add C:\ or *.exe to Defender Exclusions so scans skip them completely! Open PowerShell as Administrator and run Get-MpPreference | Select-Object ExclusionPath, ExclusionExtension, ExclusionProcess to audit every active exclusion. Immediately remove any unauthorized entry via Windows Security > Virus & threat protection > Manage settings > Exclusions (or Remove-MpPreference -ExclusionPath "C:\"), then run a Full + Offline Scan.

### How do I fix Set-MpPreference PowerShell commands failing with "Operation failed with error 0x800106ba / Access Denied"?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/set-mppreference-powershell-commands-failing-with-operation-failed-with
- Sub-Topic: Admin Locks, Tamper Protection, Group Policy & Registry Restoration
- Answer: Tamper Protection intentionally blocks PowerShell and Registry modifications to Defender core settings (DisableRealtimeMonitoring, etc.) even as Administrator! You must either run the change through the Windows Security GUI, temporarily toggle Tamper Protection OFF inside Windows Security (for approved admin maintenance), or verify WinDefend is actively running.

### How do I restore missing "Virus & threat protection" tile completely disappeared from Windows Security?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/how-do-i-restore-missing-virus-threat-protection-tile-completely-disappe
- Sub-Topic: Admin Locks, Tamper Protection, Group Policy & Registry Restoration
- Answer: Malware or corrupted policies set UILockdown = 1 or hide the Virus & Threat Protection area. Open elevated PowerShell and run Set-MpPreference -UILockdown 0, check regedit at HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender Security Center\Virus and threat protection and delete UILockdown if set to 1, then reset Microsoft.SecHealthUI and reboot.

### How do I fix Windows Security asking for UAC Administrator permission but the "Yes" button is missing/grayed out?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-security-asking-for-uac-administrator-permission-but-the-yes-but
- Sub-Topic: Admin Locks, Tamper Protection, Group Policy & Registry Restoration
- Answer: A grayed-out UAC "Yes" button means your Windows login was demoted to a Standard User account with no active Administrator account accessible. Boot into WinRE > Advanced options > Command Prompt or Safe Mode to re-enable the built-in Administrator account (net user administrator /active:yes), log in as Admin, promote your primary user back to Administrators group, and disable the built-in Admin account afterward.

### How do I fix Windows Defender Cloud-Delivered Protection and Automatic Sample Submission grayed out?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-defender-cloud-delivered-protection-and-automatic-sample-submiss
- Sub-Topic: Admin Locks, Tamper Protection, Group Policy & Registry Restoration
- Answer: Telemetry-blocking privacy tools (like O&O ShutUp10 or WPD) set SpynetReporting = 0 in Registry, locking cloud protection off. Open regedit, navigate to HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Spynet, delete SpynetReporting and SubmitSamplesConsent overrides, run gpupdate /force, and re-enable Cloud-delivered protection inside Windows Security.

### How do I fix "Windows Security Center service can't be started" error after a Windows 11 upgrade?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-security-center-service-can-t-be-started-error-after-a-windows-1
- Sub-Topic: Admin Locks, Tamper Protection, Group Policy & Registry Restoration
- Answer: Check services.msc to confirm Security Center (wscsvc) Startup Type is Automatic (Delayed Start) and its dependencies (Remote Procedure Call (RpcSs) and Windows Management Instrumentation (Winmgmt)) are Running. If WMI is corrupted, verify its repository via winmgmt /verifyrepository in elevated Command Prompt and run sfc /scannow.

### How do I fix Windows Defender Exploit Protection (CFG / DEP / ASLR) crashing legacy business apps or older games?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-defender-exploit-protection-cfg-dep-aslr-crashing-legacy-busines
- Sub-Topic: Admin Locks, Tamper Protection, Group Policy & Registry Restoration
- Answer: Windows Exploit Protection's strict memory mitigations occasionally crash older 32-bit applications. Instead of turning off System Settings globally, open Windows Security > App & browser control > Exploit protection settings > Program settings, click Add program to customize, select the specific .exe, and override Control Flow Guard (CFG) to Off solely for that application.

### How do I fix Windows Defender "Your organization requires you to use Microsoft Defender" blocking me from installing Bitdefender/Norton?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-defender-your-organization-requires-you-to-use-microsoft-defende
- Sub-Topic: Admin Locks, Tamper Protection, Group Policy & Registry Restoration
- Answer: Corporate Intune/Endpoint Manager policies lock Windows Defender as the primary security provider on work-enrolled devices. Check Settings > Accounts > Access work or school—if this is your personal PC linked to a school/employer email, disconnect the MDM management profile; if it is a company-owned laptop, IT policy forbids third-party antivirus installation.

### How do I reset ALL Windows Defender settings back to clean Microsoft factory defaults?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/all-windows-defender-settings-back-to-clean-microsoft-factory-defaults
- Sub-Topic: Admin Locks, Tamper Protection, Group Policy & Registry Restoration
- Answer: Temporarily turn off Tamper Protection if needed, delete rogue subkeys under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender, reset the UI package via Get-AppxPackage Microsoft.SecHealthUI -AllUsers | Reset-AppxPackage, run DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth, reboot, turn Tamper Protection back ON, and run Update-MpSignature.

### How do I fix "Memory integrity is off. Your device may be vulnerable" failing to turn on due to incompatible drivers?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/memory-integrity-is-off-your-device-may-be-vulnerable-failing-to-turn-on
- Sub-Topic: Core Isolation, Memory Integrity (HVCI), Incompatible Drivers & TPM
- Answer: Click Review incompatible drivers inside Windows Security > Device security > Core isolation to view the exact blocking .sys driver and Published Name (e.g., oem42.inf from an old Logitech webcam, Huawei/Samsung USB modem, Brother printer, or Western Digital driver). Update that hardware's driver first; if discontinued/unused, remove the stale driver package cleanly in elevated Command Prompt via pnputil /delete-driver oem42.inf /uninstall /force, reboot, and enable Memory Integrity.

### How do I fix Core Isolation / Memory Integrity missing completely or saying "Page not available" on Windows 11?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/core-isolation-memory-integrity-missing-completely-or-saying-page-not-av
- Sub-Topic: Core Isolation, Memory Integrity (HVCI), Incompatible Drivers & TPM
- Answer: Core Isolation requires hardware virtualization (Intel VT-x / AMD-V) enabled in BIOS/UEFI. Reboot into BIOS, enable Virtualization Technology (VTx/SVM) and VT-d / IOMMU, boot Windows, check msinfo32 to verify Virtualization-Based Security is supported, and verify HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard\Scenarios\HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity has Enabled = 1.

### How do I fix Memory Integrity blocking older Western Digital (wdcsam64_prewin8.sys), Brother, or USB-to-Serial drivers?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/memory-integrity-blocking-older-western-digital-wdcsam64-prewin8-sys-bro
- Sub-Topic: Core Isolation, Memory Integrity (HVCI), Incompatible Drivers & TPM
- Answer: Legacy pre-Windows 10 drivers like wdcsam64_prewin8.sys (WD SES driver), ene.sys (RGB lighting), or old ftdibus.sys lack HVCI code-integrity compliance. Download the latest Windows 11-signed driver from the vendor—or if the peripheral is no longer owned, locate its oemXX.inf name in the Review incompatible drivers dropdown and purge it with pnputil /delete-driver oemXX.inf /uninstall.

### How do I fix Windows Security "Local Security Authority protection is off. Your device may be vulnerable" bug even when it's ON?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-security-local-security-authority-protection-is-off-your-device
- Sub-Topic: Core Isolation, Memory Integrity (HVCI), Incompatible Drivers & TPM
- Answer: This is a well-known Windows 11 SecHealthUI reporting bug where LSA (RunAsPPL) is enabled in settings yet displays a persistent yellow warning after reboot. Update Windows Security Platform to the newest version via Windows Update, verify RunAsPPL = 2 (DWORD) and RunAsPPLBoot = 2 under HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa, and reboot.

### Does turning ON Windows 11 Memory Integrity (HVCI) hurt gaming FPS—and should gamers turn it off?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/does-turning-on-windows-11-memory-integrity-hvci-hurt-gaming-fps-and-sho
- Sub-Topic: Core Isolation, Memory Integrity (HVCI), Incompatible Drivers & TPM
- Answer: On modern CPUs with MBEC (Intel 8th Gen+ / AMD Ryzen 3000+), Memory Integrity typically affects gaming performance by only 1%–4% while blocking kernel-level rootkits and credential theft. Only older CPUs lacking MBEC suffer noticeable 5%–10% overhead—Microsoft recommends keeping Memory Integrity ON unless a specific legacy anti-cheat explicitly conflicts.

### How do I fix Windows Security "Kernel-mode Hardware-enforced Stack Protection is off" incompatible driver error?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-security-kernel-mode-hardware-enforced-stack-protection-is-off-i
- Sub-Topic: Core Isolation, Memory Integrity (HVCI), Incompatible Drivers & TPM
- Answer: Similar to Memory Integrity, Hardware-enforced Stack Protection (available on Intel 11th Gen+ / AMD Ryzen 5000+) blocks unsigned or legacy anti-cheat/RGB kernel drivers. Click Review incompatible drivers to update or remove the listed legacy .sys driver (commonly outdated BattlEye, EasyAntiCheat, or motherboard RGB utilities), then reboot and toggle it ON.

### How do I fix Windows Security "Standard hardware security not supported" under Device Security?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-security-standard-hardware-security-not-supported-under-device-s
- Sub-Topic: Core Isolation, Memory Integrity (HVCI), Incompatible Drivers & TPM
- Answer: This message appears on PCs missing TPM 2.0, UEFI Secure Boot, DEP, or UEFI MAT (or running Windows in Legacy BIOS/CSM mode). Run tpm.msc and msinfo32 to inspect BIOS Mode (must be UEFI) and Secure Boot State (must be On), then enable TPM 2.0 (fTPM/PTT) and Secure Boot in UEFI settings.

### How do I fix Windows Security "Security processor (TPM) troubleshooting — Attestation: Not Ready / Storage: Ready"?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-security-security-processor-tpm-troubleshooting-attestation-not
- Sub-Topic: Core Isolation, Memory Integrity (HVCI), Incompatible Drivers & TPM
- Answer: An unready TPM attestation state occurs after BIOS updates on AMD/Intel boards with outdated AGESA/ME firmware. Install the latest motherboard BIOS update, install all pending Windows Updates, open Windows Security > Device security > Security processor details > Security processor troubleshooting, and avoid clicking "Clear TPM" until you first back up your BitLocker Recovery Key at account.microsoft.com/devices/recoverykey!

### How do I fix Windows Defender "Vulnerable Driver Blocklist" refusing to turn on or blocking MSI Afterburner / fan control tools?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-defender-vulnerable-driver-blocklist-refusing-to-turn-on-or-bloc
- Sub-Topic: Core Isolation, Memory Integrity (HVCI), Incompatible Drivers & TPM
- Answer: Microsoft's Vulnerable Driver Blocklist blocks known exploitable signed drivers (such as legacy WinRing0.sys used by older fan/RGB utilities) to stop BYOVD ransomware attacks. Update your fan/RGB utility (e.g., FanControl, OpenRGB, MSI Center) to a modern build using non-vulnerable drivers rather than disabling the blocklist system-wide.

### How do I fix Windows 11 Smart App Control showing "Off" and grayed out ("Cannot be turned on without reinstalling Windows")?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-11-smart-app-control-showing-off-and-grayed-out-cannot-be-turned
- Sub-Topic: Core Isolation, Memory Integrity (HVCI), Incompatible Drivers & TPM
- Answer: By Microsoft's strict security design, Smart App Control can ONLY be activated on a clean installation of Windows 11 (it starts in Evaluation Mode and automatically locks permanently to Off if your PC was upgraded from Windows 10 or had incompatible unsigned apps during evaluation). Re-enabling Smart App Control requires a clean Windows 11 Reset/reinstall.

### How do I fix Smart App Control blocking a trusted downloaded installer or open-source developer tool?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/smart-app-control-blocking-a-trusted-downloaded-installer-or-open-source
- Sub-Topic: Core Isolation, Memory Integrity (HVCI), Incompatible Drivers & TPM
- Answer: Smart App Control blocks unsigned executables lacking Microsoft cloud reputation—and unlike SmartScreen, it has no per-file exclusion list. Either ask the vendor for a validly code-signed binary, or if you must run unsigned local tools regularly, switch Windows Security > App & browser control > Smart App Control from On to Off (note: turning it Off is permanent until a clean Windows reinstall).

### How do I fix Core Isolation / Memory Integrity causing BSOD (DRIVER_VERIFIER_DMA_VIOLATION or SYSTEM_SERVICE_EXCEPTION) after enabling?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/core-isolation-memory-integrity-causing-bsod-driver-verifier-dma-violati
- Sub-Topic: Core Isolation, Memory Integrity (HVCI), Incompatible Drivers & TPM
- Answer: If enabling HVCI triggers a boot loop, boot into WinRE > Troubleshoot > Advanced options > Startup Settings > Safe Mode (or Command Prompt), disable HVCI in Registry (reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard\Scenarios\HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity" /v Enabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f), reboot normally, update all chipset/Thunderbolt/USB drivers, and retest.

### How do I fix Windows Security "Firmware protection" warning or "Secured-core PC" feature unavailable?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-security-firmware-protection-warning-or-secured-core-pc-feature
- Sub-Topic: Core Isolation, Memory Integrity (HVCI), Incompatible Drivers & TPM
- Answer: Firmware Protection (System Guard Secure Launch / DRTM) requires hardware-level Secured-core CPU/BIOS support (typically business laptops like ThinkPad, Latitude, EliteBook, or Surface Pro). Consumer motherboards without DRTM hardware will not show this toggle—this is normal hardware scoping, not a broken Windows installation.

### How do I fix Windows Defender "Unauthorized changes blocked" stopping games, Photoshop, or Word from saving files?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-defender-unauthorized-changes-blocked-stopping-games-photoshop-o
- Sub-Topic: Controlled Folder Access (Ransomware Protection), SmartScreen, PUA & Exclusions
- Answer: Controlled Folder Access blocks any unrecognized executable from modifying Documents, Desktop, Pictures, or Videos (breaking PC game save files!). Open Windows Security > Virus & threat protection > Ransomware protection > Manage ransomware protection > Allow an app through Controlled folder access > Add an allowed app > Recently blocked apps, and click + next to your legitimate game or app.

### How do I add or remove custom folders protected by Windows Defender Controlled Folder Access?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/or-remove-custom-folders-protected-by-windows-defender-controlled-folder
- Sub-Topic: Controlled Folder Access (Ransomware Protection), SmartScreen, PUA & Exclusions
- Answer: Open Windows Security > Virus & threat protection > Manage ransomware protection > Protected folders. Default Windows user folders (Documents, Pictures, Videos, Music, Favorites) are permanently protected while CFA is ON, and you can click Add a protected folder to shield custom project, tax, or finance directories on secondary drives (D:\).

### How do I fix Microsoft Defender SmartScreen "Windows protected your PC" blue popup when running a safe app?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-defender-smartscreen-windows-protected-your-pc-blue-popup-when
- Sub-Topic: Controlled Folder Access (Ransomware Protection), SmartScreen, PUA & Exclusions
- Answer: SmartScreen displays the blue warning for newly released or rarely downloaded apps that haven't built global reputation yet. Verify the download URL and SHA-256 checksum/digital signature first; if 100% authentic, click More info inside the blue box and then click Run anyway—never bypass SmartScreen for unsolicited email attachments or cracked software.

### How do I fix Windows Defender deleting a safe file immediately upon download (Trojan:Win32/Wacatac.B!ml false positive)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-defender-deleting-a-safe-file-immediately-upon-download-trojan-w
- Sub-Topic: Controlled Folder Access (Ransomware Protection), SmartScreen, PUA & Exclusions
- Answer: Detections ending in !ml (Machine Learning) like Wacatac.B!ml or Sabsik.FL.A!ml are heuristic detections that occasionally falsely flag freshly compiled binaries, indie apps, or Python PyInstaller scripts. Upload the file to VirusTotal first to verify consensus across 70+ engines; if confirmed clean, open Windows Security > Protection history, expand the quarantined entry, choose Actions > Restore, and add a narrow file/folder exclusion.

### How do I fix Windows Defender blocking downloads as "Potentially Unwanted App Found" (PUA:Win32/... — e.g., Cheat Engine, uTorrent, bundled installers)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-defender-blocking-downloads-as-potentially-unwanted-app-found-pu
- Sub-Topic: Controlled Folder Access (Ransomware Protection), SmartScreen, PUA & Exclusions
- Answer: Defender's Reputation-based protection automatically blocks ad-bundled installers (PUA:Win32/OfferCore, PUA:Win32/Utorrent). Prefer clean ad-free open-source alternatives (like qBittorrent instead of uTorrent); if you intentionally need a specific utility, check Protection history > Actions > Allow on device or adjust App & browser control > Reputation-based protection > Potentially unwanted app blocking.

### How do I properly exclude a developer folder (Node.js, Python, Visual Studio, Docker) from Windows Defender to stop build slowdowns?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/exclude-a-developer-folder-node-js-python-visual-studio-docker-from-wind
- Sub-Topic: Controlled Folder Access (Ransomware Protection), SmartScreen, PUA & Exclusions
- Answer: Real-time Defender scanning of thousands of tiny node_modules or compiler .obj files slows builds dramatically. On Windows 11, either create a Dev Drive (ReFS) which uses Defender's fast asynchronous Performance Mode automatically, OR add narrow folder exclusions (e.g., C:\Projects\my-app\node_modules) under Virus & threat protection > Manage settings > Exclusions—never exclude your entire C:\ or Downloads folder!

### How do I fix Windows Defender Quarantine failing to delete or restore a stuck threat ("Remediation incomplete")?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-defender-quarantine-failing-to-delete-or-restore-a-stuck-threat
- Sub-Topic: Controlled Folder Access (Ransomware Protection), SmartScreen, PUA & Exclusions
- Answer: "Remediation incomplete" occurs when the file lives inside a locked archive, mounted ISO, Shadow Copy, or external drive that was unplugged, OR active malware re-spawns itself from Task Scheduler. Run Microsoft Defender Offline Scan, audit Task Scheduler and Startup Apps for persistence scripts, and purge stale detection logs in Safe Mode if the original file no longer exists.

### How do I fix Edge SmartScreen falsely blocking my own website or a legitimate download ("Unsafe site reported by Microsoft")?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/edge-smartscreen-falsely-blocking-my-own-website-or-a-legitimate-downloa
- Sub-Topic: Controlled Folder Access (Ransomware Protection), SmartScreen, PUA & Exclusions
- Answer: Site owners can check exact reputation status and submit a false-positive dispute directly via the official Microsoft Security Intelligence Website Submission Portal (microsoft.com/wdsi/filesubmission > Report an unsafe/incorrectly flagged website). End users should wait for verification rather than disabling SmartScreen globally.

### How do I fix Windows Defender flagging Windows activation cracks/KMS tools (HackTool:Win32/AutoKMS) that keep reappearing?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-defender-flagging-windows-activation-cracks-kms-tools-hacktool-w
- Sub-Topic: Controlled Folder Access (Ransomware Protection), SmartScreen, PUA & Exclusions
- Answer: HackTool:Win32/AutoKMS indicates an unauthorized pirated Windows/Office activator (which frequently bundles hidden infostealers or scheduled tasks that re-infect Defender). Delete the rogue KMS scheduled task inside Task Scheduler, remove unauthorized Defender exclusions, run Microsoft Defender Offline Scan, and activate Windows/Office with a legitimate retail/OEM product key.

### How do I fix Windows Security "Phishing protection" warning constantly popping up when typing my password in local apps?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-security-phishing-protection-warning-constantly-popping-up-when
- Sub-Topic: Controlled Folder Access (Ransomware Protection), SmartScreen, PUA & Exclusions
- Answer: Enhanced Phishing Protection (under App & browser control > Reputation-based protection) monitors whenever you type your Windows login password into Notepad, Word, or untrusted sites. Never reuse your Windows password on websites; if false alerts trigger in an offline local password manager, adjust Warn me about password reuse / unsafe password storage settings under Phishing protection.

### How do I fix Windows Defender blocking PowerShell scripts or Attack Surface Reduction (ASR) rules blocking Office macros?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-defender-blocking-powershell-scripts-or-attack-surface-reduction
- Sub-Topic: Controlled Folder Access (Ransomware Protection), SmartScreen, PUA & Exclusions
- Answer: Enterprise/Hardened PCs running Attack Surface Reduction (ASR) rules block Office apps from spawning child processes or running obfuscated scripts. Check Event Viewer > Applications and Services Logs > Microsoft > Windows > Windows Defender > Operational (Event IDs 1121/1122) to see the exact ASR rule GUID triggering the block, and add a scoped ASR-only exclusion if authorized.

### How do I fix Windows Defender failing to scan USB flash drives automatically when plugged in?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-defender-failing-to-scan-usb-flash-drives-automatically-when-plu
- Sub-Topic: Controlled Folder Access (Ransomware Protection), SmartScreen, PUA & Exclusions
- Answer: By default, Windows Defender does not run a full automatic scan on newly inserted USB sticks until files are accessed (Real-Time Protection scans files on open/execute). To enable automatic removable-drive scanning during full scans, open elevated PowerShell and run Set-MpPreference -DisableRemovableDriveScanning $false, or right-click any USB drive in File Explorer and choose Scan with Microsoft Defender.

### How do I fix Antimalware Service Executable (MsMpEng.exe) causing 50%–100% CPU or 1 GB+ RAM usage on Windows 11/10?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/antimalware-service-executable-msmpeng-exe-causing-50-100-cpu-or-1-gb-ra
- Sub-Topic: Windows Defender Firewall, Offline Scan, High CPU (MsMpEng.exe) & Cross-Device Microsoft Defender
- Answer: High MsMpEng.exe usage happens during scheduled background scans, definition updates, or when Defender recursively scans its own directory or massive archive files. Limit scan CPU throttle in elevated PowerShell with Set-MpPreference -ScanAvgCPULoadFactor 25, change the Windows Defender Scheduled Scan trigger in Task Scheduler to run only when idle on AC power, and avoid excluding Defender's executable insecurely.

### How do I allow a specific app, multiplayer game, or local server port through Windows Defender Firewall?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/a-specific-app-multiplayer-game-or-local-server-port-through-windows-def
- Sub-Topic: Windows Defender Firewall, Offline Scan, High CPU (MsMpEng.exe) & Cross-Device Microsoft Defender
- Answer: Open Windows Security > Firewall & network protection > Allow an app through firewall, click Change settings, locate your app, and check Private (avoid checking Public unless required on untrusted networks). For a specific port (e.g., TCP 3000 or UDP 25565), open Windows Defender Firewall with Advanced Security (wf.msc) > Inbound Rules > New Rule > Port.

### How do I fix Windows Defender Firewall blocking my local network printer, scanner, or file sharing?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-defender-firewall-blocking-my-local-network-printer-scanner-or-f
- Sub-Topic: Windows Defender Firewall, Offline Scan, High CPU (MsMpEng.exe) & Cross-Device Microsoft Defender
- Answer: Verify your Wi-Fi network profile under Settings > Network & internet > Wi-Fi > [Your Network] is set to Private network (not Public, which blocks all LAN discovery). Then open Windows Security > Firewall & network protection > Allow an app through firewall and check File and Printer Sharing for Private networks.

### How do I fix Windows Defender Firewall "For your security, some settings are managed by your system administrator" or unable to restore defaults?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-defender-firewall-for-your-security-some-settings-are-managed-by
- Sub-Topic: Windows Defender Firewall, Offline Scan, High CPU (MsMpEng.exe) & Cross-Device Microsoft Defender
- Answer: Leftover Group Policy firewall rules or third-party firewall agents lock the Windows Firewall UI. Ensure any competing antivirus firewall is uninstalled, open Command Prompt as Administrator and run netsh advfirewall reset (restores clean default firewall policies without disabling protection), and verify MpsSvc and BFE services are running.

### How do I fix Windows Defender Firewall blocking LAN Ping (ICMP) or Remote Desktop (RDP port 3389)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-defender-firewall-blocking-lan-ping-icmp-or-remote-desktop-rdp-p
- Sub-Topic: Windows Defender Firewall, Offline Scan, High CPU (MsMpEng.exe) & Cross-Device Microsoft Defender
- Answer: Windows Firewall drops incoming ICMP ping requests on Private/Public profiles by default. Open wf.msc > Inbound Rules, enable File and Printer Sharing (Echo Request - ICMPv4-In) for your Private profile (and Remote Desktop - User Mode (TCP-In) for RDP), while keeping them disabled on Public Wi-Fi profiles.

### How do I fix Microsoft Defender Offline Scan not running, restarting without scanning, or crashing on reboot?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-defender-offline-scan-not-running-restarting-without-scanning
- Sub-Topic: Windows Defender Firewall, Offline Scan, High CPU (MsMpEng.exe) & Cross-Device Microsoft Defender
- Answer: Defender Offline Scan requires a healthy Windows Recovery Environment (WinRE) partition and fails if BitLocker isn't suspended cleanly or reagentc is disabled. Run reagentc /info in elevated Command Prompt—if Status reads Disabled, run reagentc /enable, ensure 250+ MB free on the recovery partition, suspend BitLocker for 1 reboot if prompted, and re-trigger Microsoft Defender Offline scan under Scan options.

### Where do I view the results/logs of a Microsoft Defender Offline Scan after my PC reboots?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/where-do-i-view-the-results-logs-of-a-microsoft-defender-offline-scan-af
- Sub-Topic: Windows Defender Firewall, Offline Scan, High CPU (MsMpEng.exe) & Cross-Device Microsoft Defender
- Answer: Defender Offline Scan automatically reboots into Windows once finished without displaying a pop-up summary. View exact findings under Windows Security > Virus & threat protection > Protection history, OR open Event Viewer > Applications and Services Logs > Microsoft > Windows > Windows Defender > Operational and filter for Event IDs 1116 (threat detected), 1117 (action taken), and 2030 (offline scan completed).

### How do I fix Windows Defender showing an old threat in Protection History over and over even after it was deleted?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-defender-showing-an-old-threat-in-protection-history-over-and-ov
- Sub-Topic: Windows Defender Firewall, Offline Scan, High CPU (MsMpEng.exe) & Cross-Device Microsoft Defender
- Answer: Stale entries inside C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Scans\History\Service\DetectionHistory cause Windows Security to re-alert on already-removed files. Boot into Safe Mode, open C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Scans\History\Service, delete the old DetectionHistory files, reboot normally, and run a fresh Quick Scan to confirm the PC is clean.

### How do I run a Windows Defender scan or update definitions from Command Prompt / PowerShell when the GUI won't open?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/a-windows-defender-scan-or-update-definitions-from-command-prompt-powers
- Sub-Topic: Windows Defender Firewall, Offline Scan, High CPU (MsMpEng.exe) & Cross-Device Microsoft Defender
- Answer: Open PowerShell as Administrator and run: Update-MpSignature (updates definitions), Start-MpScan -ScanType QuickScan (or -ScanType FullScan), and Get-MpThreatDetection (lists all detected threats). Alternatively, use "%ProgramFiles%\Windows Defender\MpCmdRun.exe" -Scan -ScanType 1 directly in elevated Command Prompt.

### How do I fix Microsoft Defender for Individuals (Microsoft 365 Defender App) saying "Subscription required" even though I have Microsoft 365?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-defender-for-individuals-microsoft-365-defender-app-saying-sub
- Sub-Topic: Windows Defender Firewall, Offline Scan, High CPU (MsMpEng.exe) & Cross-Device Microsoft Defender
- Answer: The cross-device Microsoft Defender app (distinct from free built-in Windows Security!) requires an active Microsoft 365 Personal or Family subscription (it does not activate with one-time Office 2021/2024 Home & Student licenses or work-only Business licenses). Sign into the Microsoft Defender app using the exact personal Microsoft account shown as Active at account.microsoft.com/services.

### How do I fix Microsoft Defender Privacy Protection VPN (included in Microsoft 365) not connecting or hitting the 50 GB monthly cap?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-defender-privacy-protection-vpn-included-in-microsoft-365-not
- Sub-Topic: Windows Defender Firewall, Offline Scan, High CPU (MsMpEng.exe) & Cross-Device Microsoft Defender
- Answer: Microsoft Defender Privacy Protection provides 50 GB/month of encrypted VPN traffic (available in select regions including US, UK, Germany, Canada) and automatically pauses once the monthly cap resets on the 1st. If it fails to connect below 50 GB, disable competing VPN clients, update the Microsoft Defender app from Microsoft Store, and note Microsoft announced phased changes/retirements to the consumer VPN feature depending on region/build.

### How do I fix Microsoft Defender on macOS / iPhone / Android failing to sync device status to my Microsoft 365 Defender dashboard?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/microsoft-defender-on-macos-iphone-android-failing-to-sync-device-status
- Sub-Topic: Windows Defender Firewall, Offline Scan, High CPU (MsMpEng.exe) & Cross-Device Microsoft Defender
- Answer: On macOS, grant Full Disk Access and allow the Microsoft Defender System Extension under System Settings > Privacy & Security; on iOS, allow the local VPN profile used solely for anti-phishing link inspection (not a full VPN tunnel); on Android, grant Notification and Accessibility/File Access permissions and disable Battery Optimization so the dashboard syncs within 15 minutes.

### How do I remove an old sold or broken laptop from my Microsoft 365 Defender dashboard?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/an-old-sold-or-broken-laptop-from-my-microsoft-365-defender-dashboard
- Sub-Topic: Windows Defender Firewall, Offline Scan, High CPU (MsMpEng.exe) & Cross-Device Microsoft Defender
- Answer: Open the Microsoft Defender app (or mydefender.microsoft.com), click Device details on the old device card, and select Remove device—and also remove the old hardware from account.microsoft.com/devices so it stops displaying stale security alerts across your family dashboard.

### How do I fix Windows Defender Identity Theft Monitoring (Microsoft 365 Defender) not sending breach alerts or failing to verify my identity?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-defender-identity-theft-monitoring-microsoft-365-defender-not-se
- Sub-Topic: Windows Defender Firewall, Offline Scan, High CPU (MsMpEng.exe) & Cross-Device Microsoft Defender
- Answer: Identity Theft Monitoring (powered by Experian in the US) requires exact SSN, legal name, and current US residential address matching credit bureau headers. Confirm your personal details at mydefender.microsoft.com > Identity theft monitoring, add every personal email/phone number you want monitored, and ensure alert emails from Microsoft aren't landing in Junk.

### How do I fix Windows Defender blocking legitimate Python/Node/Docker localhost networking (localhost:3000 / WSL2)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-defender-blocking-legitimate-python-node-docker-localhost-networ
- Sub-Topic: Windows Defender Firewall, Offline Scan, High CPU (MsMpEng.exe) & Cross-Device Microsoft Defender
- Answer: Windows Defender Firewall creates separate rules for the virtual vEthernet (WSL) network adapter, which often defaults to Public and blocks host-to-WSL traffic. Open elevated PowerShell and inspect Get-NetFirewallProfile / allow the vEthernet (WSL) interface via New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "WSL" -Direction Inbound -InterfaceAlias "vEthernet (WSL)" -Action Allow (for trusted local dev ports only).

### How do I fix Windows Defender Firewall Notification spam ("Windows Defender Firewall has blocked some features of this app")?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-defender-firewall-notification-spam-windows-defender-firewall-ha
- Sub-Topic: Windows Defender Firewall, Offline Scan, High CPU (MsMpEng.exe) & Cross-Device Microsoft Defender
- Answer: Repeated firewall prompts occur when an app updates its versioned executable path (e.g., Discord, Zoom, Chrome, Java) or runs from a temporary folder. Click Allow access ONLY on Private networks for trusted apps you explicitly launched, verify the digital publisher path matches Program Files, and never click Allow on unknown background pop-ups.

### How do I fix Windows Defender flagging browser cache files (Trojan:HTML/Phish or JS/CoinMiner) repeatedly every day?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-defender-flagging-browser-cache-files-trojan-html-phish-or-js-co
- Sub-Topic: Windows Defender Firewall, Offline Scan, High CPU (MsMpEng.exe) & Cross-Device Microsoft Defender
- Answer: Repeated browser cache detections mean a malicious browser extension, compromised Sync profile, or infected bookmarked site is re-downloading the script every time Chrome/Edge opens. Audit and remove unfamiliar extensions in Chrome/Edge, clear All Time browser cache and site data, disable browser Push Notifications from unknown sites, and run a Full Scan.

### How do I check if Windows Defender is actually running and up to date via PowerShell (Get-MpComputerStatus)?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/if-windows-defender-is-actually-running-and-up-to-date-via-powershell-ge
- Sub-Topic: Windows Defender Firewall, Offline Scan, High CPU (MsMpEng.exe) & Cross-Device Microsoft Defender
- Answer: Open PowerShell and run Get-MpComputerStatus | Select-Object AMServiceEnabled, AntivirusEnabled, RealTimeProtectionEnabled, IsTamperProtected, AntivirusSignatureLastUpdated, AntivirusSignatureVersion. Every boolean field should return True, and AntivirusSignatureLastUpdated should be within the last 24–48 hours.

### How do I fix Windows Defender failing to start in Safe Mode when removing stubborn rootkits/ransomware?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-defender-failing-to-start-in-safe-mode-when-removing-stubborn-ro
- Sub-Topic: Windows Defender Firewall, Offline Scan, High CPU (MsMpEng.exe) & Cross-Device Microsoft Defender
- Answer: By design, Windows Safe Mode does NOT load WinDefend or Real-Time Protection automatically to keep troubleshooting minimal. To scan outside normal Windows, trigger Microsoft Defender Offline Scan (Start-MpWDOScan in elevated PowerShell), or run the standalone Microsoft Safety Scanner (MSERT.exe) directly inside Safe Mode.

### How do I fix Windows Security "Account protection: Dynamic Lock" or "Sign in with Microsoft for enhanced security" warning on a local Windows 11 account?
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/windows-security-account-protection-dynamic-lock-or-sign-in-with-microso
- Sub-Topic: Windows Defender Firewall, Offline Scan, High CPU (MsMpEng.exe) & Cross-Device Microsoft Defender
- Answer: Windows Security shows a yellow warning under Account protection if you intentionally use an offline Local Account instead of a Microsoft Account. You do not have to switch to a Microsoft Account—simply open Windows Security > Account protection and click Dismiss under the Microsoft Account prompt so the tray icon returns to a clean green checkmark.

- Answer: Enforce federal and state automatic renewal laws (ROSCA), stop unauthorized recurring ACH debits, and demand contract cancellation.

### Flight Cancelled or Delayed 3+ Hours: US DOT Cash Refund & EU261 Cash Claims
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/flight-cancelled-delayed-refund-eu261-usdot
- Answer: Know your passenger rights: mandatory cash refunds under 2024 US DOT rules vs up to €600 cash under European EU261 regulations.

### Neighbor's Tree Damaged Your Property or Overhanging: Legal Rights & Notice
- URL: https://answerdesk.online/guides/neighbor-property-boundary-tree-damage-notice
- Answer: Understand Massachusetts Rule self-help trimming rights, negligence liability for dead trees, and sending formal Hazard Notice.
